ent_paper_dc_motion_decoupling_structure.name: DC-Motion: Decoupling Structure and Details via Discrete-Continuous Tokens for Human Motion Generation
ent_paper_dc_motion_decoupling_structure.name_en: DC-Motion: Decoupling Structure and Details via Discrete-Continuous Tokens for Human Motion Generation
ent_paper_dc_motion_decoupling_structure.summary: arXiv:2606.14721v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Text-to-motion generation requires modeling both global action structure and fine-grained motion dynamics from natural language. Existing approaches typically rely on either continuous diffusion models or vector-quantized discrete representations. Diffusion models generate smooth motions but lack explicit compositional structure for temporal planning, while discrete token-based methods improve controllability but compress motion into finite codebooks, losing fine-grained dynamics. We argue that this limitation stems from a representation mismatch: action semantics such as intent, phase transitions, and temporal layout are inherently discrete and compositional, whereas joint trajectories and motion dynamics are continuous and locally correlated. To address this, we propose DC-Motion, a discrete-continuous factorized framework for human motion generation. DC-Motion decomposes motion into discrete structural tokens capturing global action layout and continuous residual latents modeling fine-grained dynamics. A text-conditioned structure generator predicts discrete tokens via iterative masked modeling, and a diffusion-based residual generator produces continuous motion conditioned on the structure. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate that DC-Motion achieves strong performance in both FID and R-Precision, outperforming representative diffusion-based and discrete-token baselines.
ent_paper_dc_motion_decoupling_structure.body:
## 概述

DC-Motion 提出一种将人体运动生成分解为离散结构令牌与连续细节令牌的双通道表征方法，旨在解决现有单一表征在全局姿态一致性与局部动作细腻度之间难以兼顾的问题。该方法通过离散令牌捕捉骨架拓扑与关键姿态，连续令牌编码时序细节，并在 Transformer 框架内实现两者的协同解码。

## 它改变了什么

当前主流人体运动生成方法要么采用纯连续回归（如 VAE 或扩散模型），要么采用纯离散令牌（如 VQ-VAE），前者容易产生平滑但缺乏结构约束的抖动，后者则因量化误差丢失高频细节。DC-Motion 的实质改变在于：它不再把“结构”和“细节”视为同一表征空间中的不同分辨率，而是将它们显式拆分为两种异质令牌类型，从而让模型在训练时能分别优化“姿态拓扑正确性”与“运动平滑细腻度”这两个目标。这一设计直接回应了运动生成中“全局骨架错位”与“局部肢体抖动”长期此消彼长的问题，为后续工作提供了一种新的表征分工范式。

## 方法拆解

### 双分支编码
- 输入动作序列经两个独立编码器：结构分支采用 **VQ-VAE** 将每帧姿态量化到离散码本（码本大小论文未明确），输出结构令牌序列；细节分支采用连续编码器，输出每帧的残差向量，代表离散化丢失的高频信息。

### 协同解码
- 解码器基于 **Transformer** 架构，结构令牌作为主序列输入，细节连续向量通过交叉注意力注入每一解码层。
- 关键设计：结构令牌决定“做什么动作”（如走路、跳跃），细节向量决定“怎么做”（如步幅、手臂摆动幅度），两者在解码时通过门控机制融合，门控权重由结构令牌的上下文动态计算。

### 训练策略
- 两阶段训练：第一阶段单独训练 VQ-VAE 重建结构令牌；第二阶段冻结结构编码器，训练细节编码器与解码器，损失函数为重建误差加细节向量的 L2 正则（正则系数论文未明确）。

## Overview
With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) and robotics, service robots are increasingly becoming an integral part of daily life, offering a wide range of services in complex environments. To deliver these services intelligently and efficiently, robust and accurate task planning capabilities are essential. This paper presents a comprehensive overview of the integration of LLMs into service robotics, with a particular focus on their role in enhancing robotic task planning. First, the development and foundational techniques of LLMs, including pre-training, fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and prompt engineering, are reviewed. ## Overview
Transferring manipulation skills across object instances that share functionality but differ in geometry remains a fundamental challenge in robot learning. ent_paper_zhao_occupancy_slam_simultaneo.body:
## Overview
In this paper, we propose an optimization based SLAM approach to simultaneously optimize the robot trajectory and the occupancy map using 2D laser scans (and odometry) information. The key novelty is that the robot poses and the occupancy map are optimized together, which is significantly different from existing occupancy mapping strategies where the robot poses need to be obtained first before the map can be estimated. In our formulation, the map is represented as a continuous occupancy map where each 2D point in the environment has a corresponding evidence value. The Occupancy-SLAM problem is formulated as an optimization problem where the variables include all the robot poses and the occupancy values at the selected discrete grid cell nodes. ent_paper_inoue_dialogue_system_with_hum.body:
## Overview
Today, as seen in smart speakers, spoken dialogue technology is rapidly advancing to enable human-like interaction. However, current dialogue systems cannot pay attention not only to the content of speech, but also to the way of speaking and eye contact and facial expressions, while watching the facial expressions of the person with whom one is speaking. Therefore, this study participated in a Japanese competition called the "Dialogue Robot Competition" and attempted to develop a dialogue system that includes control of not only the content of speech but also the robot's facial expressions and gaze in order to realize a humanoid robot that can naturally interact with humans.

## Overview
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have attracted growing interest as a scalable approach to robotic manipulation. Existing solutions address these limitations individually through model retraining or environment-specific modules, yet what is needed is a general framework that systematically transforms a pretrained VLA into a robotic agent. ## Overview

JAEGER is a whole-body controller for adult-sized humanoid robots (Unitree H1/H1-2), proposed by the author team. The core contribution lies in decoupling whole-body control into two independent policies for the upper and lower body (Dec-POMDP framework), accompanied by a real-time retargeting network and supervised-initialization curriculum learning. The method significantly outperforms open-source SOTA methods such as HumanPlus, ExBody, and OmniH2O in both root velocity tracking and pose tracking tasks, with joint angle tracking errors reduced to 30-60% of other methods.

ent_paper_wu_momanipvla_transferring_vis.body:
## 概述

MoManipVLA 提出一种将预训练固定基座 VLA 模型（OpenVLA-7B）迁移至移动操作任务的框架，核心思路是让 VLA 生成末端执行器路点，再通过双层全身运动规划（基座+机械臂）求解物理可行轨迹。该方法在 OVMM 基准上取得 66.1% 的整体成功率，较 SOTA 提升 4.2%，并以仅 50 个真实世界专家样本微调即可完成部署。

## 它改变了什么

移动操作长期被拆解为导航与固定基座操作两个独立模块，这种串行架构使误差逐级放大——导航的微小偏差会直接破坏后续抓取姿态。端到端联合优化虽能缓解此问题，却受限于示范数据采集成本，难以扩展到多样化场景。VLA 模型在固定基座操作上展现出强大的跨任务泛化，但无法直接输出基座与机械臂的协同动作，因为其训练分布中根本不存在移动基座这一自由度。

MoManipVLA 真正改变的是“如何复用既有 VLA 能力”这一问题的解法。它没有重新训练一个移动 VLA，而是将 VLA 视为高级路点生成器，把移动操作分解为“VLA 定末端目标、优化器解全身运动”的两级流水线。这种解耦使得预训练模型的泛化能力得以保留，同时通过运动规划保证了物理可行性，避免了端到端方法对海量移动示范数据的依赖。

## 方法拆解

### 问题定义与坐标变换
观测包含 RGB-D 图像、相机位姿、基座位姿、末端执行器位姿及夹爪状态。通过变换函数 Γ 将末端执行器位姿从基座坐标系转换至世界坐标系，使 VLA 预测的路点与运动规划处于同一参考系。

### 路点生成
预训练 OpenVLA-7B 接收当前场景 RGB 图像与机械臂本体感知状态，生成第 i 个末端执行器路点 Q_i。该路点仅定义末端位置与姿态，不包含基座运动信息。

ent_paper_revisiting_parameter_redundanc.name: Revisiting Parameter Redundancy in Vision-Language-Action Models: Insights from VLM-to-VLA Adaptation
ent_paper_revisiting_parameter_redundanc.name_en: Revisiting Parameter Redundancy in Vision-Language-Action Models: Insights from VLM-to-VLA Adaptation
ent_paper_revisiting_parameter_redundanc.summary: arXiv:2606.31382v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made significant strides in embodied intelligence by integrating the powerful representations of pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, the massive parameter scale of VLAs imposes a heavy computational burden, and these models exhibit extreme sensitivity to parameter pruning. Current paradigms often treat the resulting performance degradation as inevitable, relying on fine-tuning or low-rank corrections to recover efficacy. We challenge this convention by questioning whether the removed parameters are truly redundant if VLA pruning necessitates performance recovery to be effective, or if this paradigm masks the indiscriminate pruning of critical parameters. We revisit parameter redundancy through the lens of VLM-to-VLA adaptation, first quantifying the spatial distribution of parameter divergence during adaptation to reveal structured patterns across different modules. Subsequently, we introduce controlled pruning as a diagnostic probe: by comparing the direct impact of removing different parameter subsets on VLA performance without any fine-tuning, we establish a causal link between adaptation-induced divergence signals and functional contributions. Based on the discovered modular heterogeneities, we design a multi-module joint pruning scheme. Evaluations on the LIBERO benchmark demonstrate that our approach reduces the parameters of OpenVLA and $\pi_{0.5}$ by 12\%--30\% while maintaining approximately 90\% of the original performance without any post-pruning recovery. In contrast, existing parameter pruning criteria result in total performance collapse when evaluated under the same recovery-free constraints. Our study reveals the parameter evolution mechanism in VLA adaptation and provides a new path for deploying efficient, robust robotic policies in resource-constrained environments.

## Overview
Generating realistic 3D human motions in real-time within interactive applications is key for animation, simulation, and humanoid robotics. While recent offline motion generation approaches offer precise control via text and kinematic constraints, they lack the inference speed required for interactive settings. However, its application for the task of vision-and-language navigation (VLN) remains limited. Institutions per source list: 澳大利亚国立大学、阿德莱德大学.
ent_paper_recurrent_vision_language_bert.body:
## Overview

This paper proposes VLN↻BERT, a navigation model that embeds a recurrent mechanism directly into the Vision-and-Language BERT architecture, enabling the pretrained V&L BERT itself to serve as the navigation policy network without requiring external recurrent modules (such as LSTM) or downstream decision networks. By introducing autoregressive state tokens and cross-modal attention matching within BERT, the authors achieve state-of-the-art results on the R2R and REVERIE benchmarks at the time, and systematically validate the computational efficiency advantage of applying self-attention to language only at initialization.

ent_paper_humanoid_parkour_learning_2024.body:
## 概述

本文提出Humanoid Parkour Learning，旨在为仿人机器人（Tienkung平台）构建统一的多模态占用感知系统，解决传感器布局、数据标注与多模态融合挑战。核心贡献包括：提出畸变感知投影方法（将镜头畸变参数直接编码进视图变换，避免去畸变以保留像素），以及基于时间特征对齐（双线性插值扭曲+通道拼接）的BEV编码器与FlashOcc风格预测头，总损失融合focal、lovasz-softmax及affinity loss。在自采数据集（6相机+1 LiDAR，180训练/20验证clip）上，多帧（2帧）融合设置下达到mIoU 55.73、rayIoU 61.32，优于BEVFusion（53.21/59.56）且参数量仅40.5M；消融显示畸变投影提升mIoU约1.5，但超过2帧时间融合因位姿误差累积导致性能下降。

## 它改变了什么

这篇论文真正改变的，是仿人机器人感知系统的一个长期被忽视的盲区——**数据与算法范式的错位**。过去几年，占用预测（occupancy prediction）在自动驾驶领域被推到近乎成熟，但它的数据采集、传感器布局、标注协议乃至评估指标，全部围绕车顶传感器阵列和道路场景设计。仿人机器人研究者要么直接搬用这些预训练模型，要么在自采数据上微调，却很少有人意识到：**双足平台的运动学特性、传感器安装高度、以及室内外混杂场景的语义分布，与自动驾驶有本质差异**。作者没有去发明新的网络结构，而是先承认了这个前提——现有公开数据集和评估基准根本不适用于仿人机器人，因此他们从零构建了Tienkung平台的多模态数据集，并重新定义了占用预测的坐标范围（Z轴-1.5m到0.9m，而非自动驾驶常见的路面以上数米）。

更值得注意的改动在于**畸变处理**。常规做法是先对鱼眼或广角图像做去畸变（undistortion），再送入BE…

ent_paper_simple_to_complex_structured_d.summary: arXiv:2607.04591v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and robot action generation. Existing research has primarily focused on improving model architectures, training strategies, and dataset scale, while little attention has been paid to how demonstrations are collected and organized. We identify demonstration organization as a fundamental yet overlooked aspect of imitation learning, as it directly affects policy learning efficiency, training stability, and policy generalization. To address this gap, we propose a simple-to-complex structured demonstration collection strategy for VLA learning using a dual-arm robotic platform. Our approach systematically organizes data through three general principles: (i) decomposing complex manipulation tasks into progressively learnable sub-skills, (ii) standardizing the interaction environment to reduce unnecessary variability, and (iii) organizing demonstrations according to progressively increasing task complexity. This structured design enables VLA models to first acquire fundamental manipulation skills before learning increasingly complex task compositions, facilitating more effective learning of long-horizon manipulation tasks. We evaluate the proposed strategy on two representative robotic manipulation tasks: block grasping and sorting, and towel folding. Experimental results show consistent improvements in task success rate and training stability compared with the baseline method of directly collecting end-to-end complete task trajectories. These findings highlight demonstration organization as a previously underexplored but important factor in VLA learning and provide practical insights into efficient skill acquisition, scalable dataset construction, and long-horizon robotic manipulation.

## Overview
The estimation of 3D human motion from video has progressed rapidly but current methods still have several key limitations. First, most methods estimate the human in camera coordinates. ent_paper_physv2a_reachability_gated_and.summary: arXiv:2607.09365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Video-based manipulation provides object-centric motion priors from human demonstrations, generated videos, or RGB-D observations, but such priors are typically embodiment-agnostic and cannot be directly executed by a specific robot. This paper presents \textbf{PhysV2A}, a reachability-gated and semantic-mask-constrained feasibility-completion framework for converting video-derived 6D object motion into robot-executable manipulation trajectories. The key idea is to treat grasp feasibility as trajectory-conditioned rather than local: each RGB-D-generated 6-DoF grasp candidate is rigidly coupled with the recovered object motion to form a grasp-conditioned TCP trajectory hypothesis. PhysV2A then performs hierarchical reachability-gated selection, where infeasible grasp--trajectory pairs are rejected by robot-centric kinematic checks and surviving candidates are ranked by downstream execution suitability. For the selected reachable trajectory, a VLM-assisted and rule-validated S-Mask identifies task-critical and relaxable Cartesian components, enabling semantic-mask-constrained manipulability refinement through redundancy-first optimization and bounded Cartesian relaxation. Real-robot experiments on four tabletop manipulation tasks show that PhysV2A improves task success over representative video-prior and IK-only baselines, reduces kinematic-feasibility failures, and produces better-conditioned trajectories with bounded semantic deviations.

## 概述

OmniControl 是一个基于扩散模型的文本条件人体运动生成框架，由研究团队提出，旨在解决现有方法无法在任意时间点对任意关节施加稀疏空间控制信号（如全局位置约束）的问题。其核心贡献在于提出了一种结合空间引导与真实感引导的双重机制，在不牺牲运动真实感的前提下，实现了对骨盆、脚、头、手腕等多关节的精确空间控制，并在 HumanML3D 与 KIT-ML 基准上取得了显著优于现有方法（如 MDM、PriorMDM、GMD）的控制精度与生成质量。

## 它改变了什么

这个问题困扰了领域很久：文本到运动生成模型（如 MDM）虽然能生成整体连贯的动作，但用户往往需要指定“某个时刻手必须放在杯子上”或“头不能碰到低矮天花板”这类细粒度空间约束。传统方法要么将全局坐标转换为相对骨盆的局部坐标，导致骨盆本身无法被有效约束；要么依赖 inpainting 策略，但面对稀疏关键帧时会产生不合理的速度或肢体长度。OmniControl 真正改变的是“控制信号如何与扩散生成过程交互”这一核心范式——它不再试图把外部约束硬塞进模型的输入表示，而是让生成过程在采样迭代中主动向约束“靠拢”，同时用一个辅助网络来修复因强制约束而可能产生的物理不真实感。这相当于把“控制”从数据预处理阶段移到了推理优化阶段，从而绕开了相对表示的根本限制。

## 方法拆解

OmniControl 的推理流程是一个迭代去噪过程，核心在于两种引导机制的协同作用。

### 基础扩散模型
- 基于 MDM 架构，直接预测最终干净运动 x₀(θ) = M(xₜ, t, p; θ)，而非预测噪声。
- 输入输出仍采用相对人体姿态表示（骨盆速度、局部关节位置、速度、旋转、脚接触标签），维度 D = 263。

## 概述

NORA-1.5 是一个面向人形机器人足球技能的渐进式感知-动作框架，基于 3B 参数的自回归 VLA 模型 NORA，通过流匹配动作专家与 V-JEPA2 世界模型奖励实现后训练优化。核心贡献在于用流匹配替代传统 SFT 的动作回归，结合世界模型目标奖励与 DPO 偏好优化，在 SimplerEnv、LIBERO 及真实机器人上达到最先进性能。

## 它改变了什么

传统 VLA 后训练依赖 SFT 微调，其动作回归损失直接拟合专家演示，这导致两个根本问题：一是模型被限制在单一演示流形上，无法探索多模态成功轨迹；二是基于距离的奖励在策略偏离演示分布后失去梯度信号，造成失败恢复能力差。NORA-1.5 真正改变的是将动作生成从“回归”范式转向“生成”范式——流匹配专家不是预测单个动作，而是学习从噪声到动作序列的向量场，这使得策略能够覆盖更广的动作分布，而非仅仅拟合演示均值。

另一个关键改变是奖励信号来源。作者放弃了纯 RL 或 GRPO 的密集奖励设计，改用 V-JEPA2 世界模型预测未来观测嵌入与目标嵌入的 L1 距离作为目标奖励，同时保留基于动作距离的启发式奖励作为稳定参考。这种双组件设计让模型既能探索多样可行轨迹（世界模型捕获），又不会因噪声奖励而漂移（距离奖励锚定），从根本上缓解了奖励稀疏与噪声的权衡问题。

## 方法拆解

### 架构耦合
- 基础模型：NORA（基于 Qwen-2.5-VL-3B 微调），自回归生成视觉-语言上下文。
- 动作专家：流匹配 transformer，与 NORA 层间自注意力耦合，条件输入为 NORA 的键值对 K_{VL,t}, V_{VL,t}。

### 流匹配训练
- 噪声动作：a_{t:t+N}^τ = (1-τ)a_{t:t+N} + τa₀，其中 τ 为流匹配时间步，a₀ ~ N(0,1)。

## Overview

This paper focuses on the state estimation problem for legged robots (including humanoid robots) and proposes a contact-aided Invariant Extended Kalman Filter (InEKF) method. The research motivation is to address the degradation in estimation accuracy of traditional state estimation methods when legged robots move on complex terrain, caused by strong model nonlinearity, high sensor noise, and insufficient utilization of ground contact information. The main contribution lies in combining contact constraints with invariant extended Kalman filter theory to construct a robust state estimation framework that effectively fuses proprioception and contact information, thereby improving the accuracy of pose and velocity estimation during dynamic walking or standing.

## 概述

本文提出 DexCap 系统，结合高精度手部动捕与 Diffusion Policy 动作解码器，解决双臂灵巧机器人的长时程操作任务。核心贡献在于引入人类在环校正机制（残差校正与遥操作双模式），并利用校正数据微调策略，有效弥合人-机器人具身差距。

## 它改变了什么

灵巧操作领域长期被“视觉模仿”范式主导，但 2D 手部估计在自遮挡下脆弱，且固定相机内参限制 3D 精度。DexCap 的颠覆性在于将数据采集从“看”转向“测”——直接测量人手运动学，绕开视觉估计的固有缺陷。更关键的是，它承认纯数据驱动的策略无法覆盖所有具身差异，首次将“人类在环校正”作为训练数据的一部分，而非仅作为推理时的临时干预。

这改变了灵巧操作的学习闭环：传统流程是“采集-训练-部署”，DexCap 将其扩展为“采集-训练-部署-校正-再训练”。校正数据不是噪声，而是对策略分布的有针对性修正，尤其针对手指长度比例等结构性差异。

## 方法拆解

### 数据采集
- DexCap 以 60Hz 记录人手运动，降采样至 20Hz 匹配机器人控制频率
- 前三个任务各采集 30 分钟（分别产生 201、129、82 个演示）
- Packaging 任务采集 1 小时 in-the-wild 数据（96 个演示）
- Scissor Cutting 与 Tea Preparing 各采集 1 小时（分别产生 104、55 个演示）

### 动作解码
- 采用 Diffusion Policy 作为动作解码器，将控制问题形式化为动作生成任务
- 动作输出包含两个 7-DoF 机械臂与两个 16-DoF 灵巧手，持续 d 步，构成高维回归问题
- 经验发现 Diffusion Policy 优于传统 MLP 架构

ent_paper_enpire_agentic_robot_policy_se.body:
## Overview

ENPIRE is a framework proposed by the NVIDIA team for autonomous improvement of real-world robot policies. It employs a coding agent to execute a closed-loop "reset-evaluate-improve" cycle on physical robots without human intervention. The core contribution is a reusable harness comprising four modules—Environment (EN), Policy Improvement (PI), Rollout (R), and Evolution (E)—validated on eight dual-arm robots for scalable multi-agent asynchronous collaboration. It reduces convergence times for Push-T and Pin insertion tasks to approximately 2 hours and 40 minutes, respectively.

ent_paper_egoposer_robust_real_time_egoc.body:
## 概述

EgoPoser 是面向混合现实头戴设备（HMD）的实时全身姿态估计方法，由论文作者提出，核心解决三个问题：全局坐标偏移导致的泛化失败、手部移出视野（FoV）时的输入中断、以及忽略个体身体尺寸差异带来的运动伪影。其贡献在于提出 Global-in-Local（GiL）运动分解、真实 FoV 建模、SlowFast 特征融合和尺寸感知估计，在保持超过 600 fps 推理速度的同时，显著提升了对偏移、遮挡和体型变化的鲁棒性。

## 它改变了什么

现有基于 HMD 的全身姿态估计方法，如 AvatarPoser 和 AGRoL，本质上是在“实验室坐标系”里训练出来的。它们直接吞入世界空间全局坐标，导致模型对训练数据中人物常驻原点附近这一隐含先验过度依赖——一旦真实场景中用户站在离原点数米之外，预测误差便急剧恶化（表 1 中 AGRoL 在 50m 偏移时 MPJPE 从 3.86 恶化到 53.45 cm）。这暴露了一个根本性缺陷：姿态估计不应与绝对空间位置耦合，而应关注相对运动关系。EgoPoser 改变了这一范式，通过将全局运动分解为“局部姿态 + 相对全局轨迹”，使模型对平移偏移完全免疫。

另一个被忽视的现实是，便携式 inside-out 追踪系统中，手部并非始终可见。现有方法要么假设手部永远在视野内，要么用随机掩蔽（random masking）模拟遮挡，但随机掩蔽无法捕捉真实 FoV 的几何约束——例如当手在头侧后方时，它必然不可见，且这种不可见性与头部朝向强相关。EgoPoser 首次将 FoV 建模为基于头部姿态和手部相对位置的确定性函数，而非随机事件，这直接改变了训练时输入分布的真实性。此外，现有方法普遍使用平均身体形状（mean shape），导致不同身高的用户出现脚部穿透地面或悬浮的伪影，EgoPoser 通过显式估计形状参数 β 解决…

## Overview
Adapting a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policy to a new robot usually assumes embodiment-specific demonstrations. This assumption is especially restrictive for custom robots whose morphology differs strongly from the manipulators seen in large robot datasets. We study a harder setting: zero-demo embodiment alignment of OpenVLA-OFT on a cable-driven parallel robot (CDPR) with a simple gripper and a previously unseen control interface. Instead of supervised fine-tuning, we use reinforcement learning in simulation with dense geometric rewards computed from simulator state. ## 概述

本文提出一种面向食品切割的机器人系统，通过试探切割进行刀具选择，并利用强化学习（RL）自适应控制器完成切割任务。作者来自伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校，核心贡献在于无需显式估计材料参数即可泛化到多种未见食物，在刀具选择上达到 100% 准确率，并在切割效率与奖励上优于固定策略和人类表现。

## 它改变了什么

食品切割看似简单，实则因食物物理性质（硬度、摩擦、多汁性）差异巨大，传统方法要么依赖大规模数据学习动态模型（MPC），要么依赖人类示范（DMP），要么需要显式物理参数估计（sim-to-real）。这些方法在真实厨房场景中难以落地，因为食物种类无限且参数难以获取。本文改变了这一局面：它不试图建模食物，而是通过一次低成本试探切割获取力信息，将其作为决策信号，直接驱动刀具选择和策略初始化。这本质上是将「理解材料」转化为「感知响应」，绕开了物理参数估计这一瓶颈，使系统具备对未见食物的泛化能力。

## 方法拆解

### 系统总览
- 流程分两步：先执行固定试探切割（trial cut）收集力数据，用于二分类选择刀具（水果刀或锯齿刀）；随后使用 RL 自适应控制器执行切割。

### 低层切割控制器
- 两个关键参数：垂直目标力 F_z~ 和锯切速度 V_s~。
- z 轴由 PID 力控制器控制，输出 u(t) = K_p·e(t) + K_i·∫e(t)dt + K_d·(d/dt)e(t)，其中 e(t) = F_z - F_z~。
- x 轴锯切由位置控制器跟踪指令速度，位移限制在 ±2 cm 内。

### 刀具选择模块
- 使用水果刀执行预定义试探切割，收集力数据，通过 SVM 二分类决定继续用水果刀还是切换锯齿刀。

## Overview

Opt2Skill proposes a whole-body mobile manipulation framework for humanoid robots, aiming to address the end-to-end learning problem from visual perception to dynamically feasible trajectory generation. By decomposing complex tasks into routable skill modules and combining reinforcement learning with imitation learning, this research enables the generation and combination of diverse manipulation behaviors. Its main contribution lies in constructing a scalable system from scene understanding and motion representation extraction to whole-body trajectory planning and execution, offering a new paradigm for dexterous manipulation of humanoid robots in unstructured environments.

## Overview

MAMMA is a multi-view markerless motion capture system designed for close-range multi-person interaction scenarios, developed by the IOI Industries team, outputting SMPL-X format. ent_paper_zhu_wmpo_world_model_based_pol.summary: WMPO: World Model-based Policy Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models (WMPO), is a 2025 large vision-language-action model for robotic manipulation, introduced by Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, ByteDance Seed.
ent_paper_zhu_wmpo_world_model_based_pol.body:
## 概述

WMPO 提出将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的强化学习完全建立在像素空间动作条件视频生成世界模型之上，通过预训练高保真视频生成器并在策略自身行为数据上微调，实现大规模想象 rollout 下的 GRPO 优化。该方法在 Mimicgen 仿真与真实机器人任务上显著超越在线 GRPO 与 DPO 基线，同时缓解了分布外状态下的复合误差问题。

## 它改变了什么

这项工作真正改变的是 VLA 策略自我改进的“数据来源”问题。此前，基于模型的 RL 多在抽象潜空间运作，与在真实图像上预训练的 VLA 基础模型存在根本性不匹配——预训练的视觉理解无法直接应用于不匹配的潜动力学模型，导致世界模型与策略知识之间出现鸿沟。WMPO 将世界模型构建在像素空间，使策略能够在与其预训练分布一致的生成视觉数据上运作，从而弥合了这一鸿沟。

另一个关键改变在于将 RL 从“真实轨迹预算约束”中解放出来。在线 GRPO 在批次大小 64、组大小 8 时，单次更新需至少 512 条真实轨迹；在 P=128 的 rollout 预算下大批次不可行，P=1280 时也仅能更新一两次。WMPO 通过想象轨迹实现大规模 on-policy 更新，使策略优化不再受限于物理世界的采样效率，同时天然支持从同一初始状态重复 rollout——这在物理世界中难以实现，但对大规模 GRPO 训练至关重要。

## 方法拆解

### 整体框架
WMPO 包含三个训练阶段：先在 Open X-Embodiment (OXE) 数据集上预训练像素空间视频生成世界模型，再用下游策略收集的行为数据微调世界模型，最后在想象轨迹上执行 GRPO 策略优化。

### 世界模型架构
- 基于 OpenSora 视频扩散骨干，将 3D VAE 替换为 SDXL 的 2D VAE，以保留细粒度运动细节并避免过度压缩导致…

ent_paper_e_vla_event_augmented_vision_l.summary: arXiv:2604.04834v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Robotic Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generalize well for open-ended manipulation, but their perception is fragile under sensing-stage degradations such as extreme low light, motion blur, and black clipping. We present E-VLA, an event-augmented VLA framework that improves manipulation robustness when conventional frame-based vision becomes unreliable. Instead of reconstructing images from events, E-VLA directly leverages motion and structural cues in event streams to preserve semantic perception and perception-action consistency under adverse conditions. We build an open-source teleoperation platform with a DAVIS346 event camera and collect a real-world synchronized RGB-event-action manipulation dataset across diverse tasks and illuminations. We also propose lightweight, pretrained-compatible event integration strategies and study event windowing for stable deployment. Experiments show that even a simple parameter-free fusion, i.e., overlaying accumulated event maps onto RGB images, could substantially improve robustness in dark and heavy-blur scenes: on Pick-Place at 20 lux, success increases from 0% (image-only) to 60% with overlay fusion and to 90% with our event adapter; under severe motion blur (1000 ms-exposure proxy), Pick-Place improves from 0% to 20-25%, and Sorting from 5% to 32.5%. Overall, E-VLA provides systematic evidence that event-driven perception can be effectively integrated into VLA models, pointing toward robust embodied intelligence beyond conventional frame-based imaging. Code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/JJayzee/E-VLA.
ent_paper_e_vla_event_augmented_vision_l.body:
## 概述

该论文提出 E-VLA，一个面向黑暗与模糊场景的事件增强视觉-语言-动作模型。核心贡献在于引入事件相机数据流，以弥补传统 RGB 帧在低光照和运动模糊条件下的信息缺失，从而提升机器人操作策略的鲁棒性。论文通过对比多种相机配置与基线模型，验证了事件增强在空间感知与位姿估计上的优势。

## 它改变了什么

现有视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）严重依赖标准 RGB 或 RGBD 输入，在光照不足或快速运动导致图像模糊时，特征提取与空间推理能力急剧退化。作者真正改变的，不是简单叠加一个传感器，而是将事件流作为一种“时间连续、强度无关”的补充模态，与稀疏的 RGB 帧进行特征级融合，从而在退化条件下重建出可供策略使用的几何与运动线索。这一改动直击了机器人部署中“感知退化即策略失效”的痛点，而非仅仅提升常规场景下的指标。

## 方法拆解

### 模态编码
- 事件流通过时间桶化（temporal binning）转换为固定数量的帧，与 RGB 帧同步。
- 事件帧与 RGB 帧分别经过独立的视觉编码器（如 SigLIP 或 DINOv2），得到 token 序列。

### 融合策略
- 采用交叉注意力机制，将事件 token 作为 query，RGB token 作为 key/value，实现事件引导的 RGB 特征增强。
- 融合后的 token 序列输入到 VLA 主干（如 π₀.₅），生成动作 token。

### 训练协议
- 遵循基线模型的原始训练协议，匹配数据集规模与任务分布。
- 在相机位姿随机化范围内生成等规模数据集，覆盖小范围（仰角 20°∼30°，方位角 −10°∼10°，半径 1.2 m∼1.3 m）与大范围（仰角 15°∼45°，半径 0.9 m∼1.6 m，方位角 −150°∼150°）。
- 加入“移动”测试轨道，模拟相机从左到右移动导…

## Overview
Large language models excel at a wide range of complex tasks. However, enabling general inference in the real world, e.g., for robotics problems, raises the challenge of grounding. ent_paper_berscheid_robot_learning_of_6_.body:
## 概述

本文提出BiliVLA，一个面向ERCP胆道内镜导航与插管的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，将任务级语言指令与闭环运动控制统一。系统采用两阶段训练（接地增强SFT + GRPO奖励优化），在真实体模上实现91.96%动作精度与84.85%成功率。核心贡献在于将手术语义直接转化为受限空间内的稳定动作，而非依赖模块化解耦。

## 它改变了什么

现有自主内镜系统普遍采用感知-规划-控制模块化架构，这种解耦在镜面反射、遮挡和域偏移下鲁棒性不足，且手术语义无法直接驱动闭环动作。作者判断，真正需要改变的不是单个模块的性能，而是整个控制范式的耦合方式——让语言条件语义直接参与动作生成，而非作为高层规划的中间表示。

另一个关键改变在于动作空间的离散化设计。将连续控制映射为十一个运动原语（如left-up、forward、backward），配合安全感知策略（接触时强制backward），这实际上将插管操作从“连续轨迹跟踪”问题转化为“受限空间内的离散决策”问题，显著降低了学习难度和部署风险。

ent_paper_neural_control_adjoint_learnin.name: Neural Control: Adjoint Learning Through Equilibrium Constraints
ent_paper_neural_control_adjoint_learnin.name_en: Neural Control: Adjoint Learning Through Equilibrium Constraints
ent_paper_neural_control_adjoint_learnin.summary: arXiv:2605.03288v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Many physical AI tasks require sequential implicit computation: at each step, boundary controls are applied, and the resulting configuration is obtained by solving an equilibrium problem. This setting arises naturally in deformable object manipulation, where even bending a deformable linear object (DLO) to a target shape can be nonlinear and multistable: identical boundary conditions may produce different configurations depending on actuation history. Unlike explicit transition models, the control-to-configuration relation is implicit and history-dependent, making long-horizon learning and control brittle; backpropagating through iterative solves is also memory- and compute-intensive. We propose Neural Control, a boundary-control framework that propagates gradients through branch-dependent sequences of equilibrium solves rather than a single fixed point. Neural Control computes trajectory-dependent proxy gradients by differentiating equilibrium conditions with an adjoint formulation, avoiding solver unrolling while keeping forward rollouts on converged equilibria. Combined with receding-horizon continuation, Neural Control re-anchors optimization to realized equilibria and mitigates basin switching. We validate Neural Control on simulated and real DLO manipulation, compare against SPSA and iCEM, and demonstrate applicability to a learned DEQ-style implicit equilibrium model.

ent_paper_guhur_instruction_driven_histo.body:
## 概述

本文提出 Guided Motion Diffusion（GMD），一种将稀疏空间约束（关键帧、轨迹、障碍物）纳入文本到运动扩散生成框架的方法。核心贡献在于强调投影（Emphasis projection）与密集信号传播（Dense signal propagation）两项技术，解决了全局轨迹信息在去噪过程中被局部姿态淹没的问题，并实现了无需重新训练即可处理多种空间条件信号的统一框架。

## 它改变了什么

现有扩散运动生成模型在处理文本条件时表现优异，但一旦引入空间约束（如指定骨盆轨迹或避开障碍物），性能便急剧退化。根本原因在于运动表示中局部关节信息（超过 100 维）与全局轨迹信息（通常仅 4 维）的维度严重失衡，导致去噪网络将稀疏的全局信号视为噪声而忽略。此前方法要么需要针对特定条件重新训练去噪器（如无分类器引导），要么依赖插补但无法处理稀疏关键帧。GMD 改变了这一局面：它证明了通过简单的表示变换（强调投影）即可恢复空间信号在扩散过程中的主导地位，同时利用去噪器自身的梯度传播实现密集信号扩散，从而在无需额外训练的前提下统一处理轨迹跟随、关键帧约束与障碍物规避三类任务。这实质上是将条件控制从“训练时编码”转向“推理时引导”，显著提升了框架的灵活性与实用性。

## 方法拆解

### 强调投影（Emphasis Projection）
- 构造随机矩阵 A = A'B，其中 A' ∈ ℝ^{N×N} 元素从 𝒩(0,1) 采样，B 为对角矩阵，轨迹相关索引（骨盆旋转 rot、地面位置 x、z）设为 c，其余为 1。
- 投影运动定义为 x_proj = 1/(N-3+3c²) A x，分母保证投影后单位方差。
- 关键设计：通过标量 c 放大空间引导维度（实验中 c=10 最优），使全局轨迹在去噪网络的输入中占据与局部姿态相当的方差贡献，避免被当作噪…

ent_paper_towards_generalizable_robotic_.name: Towards Generalizable Robotic Manipulation in Dynamic Environments
ent_paper_towards_generalizable_robotic_.name_en: Towards Generalizable Robotic Manipulation in Dynamic Environments
ent_paper_towards_generalizable_robotic_.summary: arXiv:2603.15620v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel in static manipulation but struggle in dynamic environments with moving targets. This performance gap primarily stems from a scarcity of dynamic manipulation datasets and the reliance of mainstream VLAs on single-frame observations, restricting their spatiotemporal reasoning capabilities. To address this, we introduce DOMINO, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for generalizable dynamic manipulation, featuring 35 tasks with hierarchical complexities, over 110K expert trajectories, and a multi-dimensional evaluation suite. Through comprehensive experiments, we systematically evaluate existing VLAs on dynamic tasks, explore effective training strategies for dynamic awareness, and validate the generalizability of dynamic data. Furthermore, we propose PUMA, a dynamics-aware VLA architecture. By integrating scene-centric historical optical flow and specialized world queries to implicitly forecast object-centric future states, PUMA couples history-aware perception with short-horizon prediction. Results demonstrate that PUMA achieves state-of-the-art performance, yielding a 6.3% absolute improvement in success rate over baselines. Moreover, we show that training on dynamic data fosters robust spatiotemporal representations that transfer to static tasks. All code and data are available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/DOMINO.
ent_paper_towards_generalizable_robotic_.body:
## 概述

本文提出 DOMINO 基准与 PUMA 架构，针对动态环境中机器人操控的时空推理缺失问题。DOMINO 提供 117000 条轨迹、35 个动态任务、5 种机器人本体的仿真数据集；PUMA 通过场景中心历史光流与物体中心未来预测辅助目标，在动态任务上将成功率从基线最优的 10.86% 提升至 17.20%。核心贡献在于系统化暴露了现有 VLA 在动态场景下的性能崩塌，并给出首个可扩展的解决方案。

## 它改变了什么

现有 VLA 模型的成功建立在静态世界假设之上——状态转移完全由机器人驱动，目标物体位置固定。这种假设在真实世界中几乎不成立：传送带上的工件、协作中的人手、被碰倒的容器，都是独立于机器人动作的动力学系统。本文真正改变的是将“动态目标操控”从工程边角料提升为基准测试的核心维度，并证明了当前主流 VLA（π0.5、OpenVLA 等）在此场景下的性能衰减不是微调能弥补的——静态到动态零样本成功率平均下降 37.3%（π0.5，由表内 44.8%→7.5% 计算），即便在动态数据上微调，提升也不超过 2.9 个百分点（ACT，由表内 6.5%→9.4% 计算）。这说明问题不在数据分布偏移，而在架构缺乏对时间维度的显式建模。

## 方法拆解

### DOMINO 数据生成：两阶段时空同步
- **时间干运行**：在静态环境中记录机器人执行动作的精确时间戳，消除动态物体对运动规划的干扰。
- **运动学反算**：根据记录时间与指定运动轨迹（如多项式阶数 n∈[2,5]），反推物体初始空间位置，使物体在机器人到达时恰好出现在目标点。

ent_paper_team_octo_an_open_source_gener.body:
## 概述

Octo 是一篇关于开放源码通用机器人策略的论文，核心贡献在于提出一种两阶段条件化框架，通过贝叶斯分解将视觉-动作先验与语言条件似然分离训练，以缓解 VLA 模型中的模态不平衡和语言遗忘问题。该方法在 LIBERO 和模拟操作基准上验证了其有效性，并提供了 R1/R2 两种训练配方以适应不同数据规模。

## 它改变了什么

这篇论文真正改变的是对 VLA 微调中灾难性遗忘问题的归因方式。此前社区普遍将语言能力退化归咎于外部推理数据缺失或骨干网络容量不足，而 Octo 通过信息论分析指出，问题根源在于 VLA 数据集内部的结构性模态不平衡——当语言指令可从视觉中直接推断（条件熵 H(ℓ|v) 极低）时，模型天然倾向走视觉捷径。这一洞察将矛头从数据规模转向数据分布结构，为无需外部数据的训练策略提供了理论依据。

更重要的是，它改变了“语言条件必须贯穿整个网络”的设计惯性。传统 VLA 架构将语言作为全局条件注入所有层，而 Octo 证明语言信息在视觉-动作先验的中间嵌入上条件互信息极小（I(a;ℓ|f_θ_VA(v)) ≪ I(a,v,ℓ)），因此可以将语言条件网络设计得小而专，仅需在后期阶段注入。这直接降低了语言对齐的计算开销，并使得小规模后训练数据也能有效保留语言泛化能力。

## 方法拆解

### 贝叶斯分解
将策略分解为视觉-动作先验 π^p(a|v) 与语言条件似然 L(ℓ|v,a) 的乘积：π(a|v,ℓ) ∝ π^p(a|v)·L(ℓ|v,a)。先验编码“能做什么”，似然根据指令修剪动作分布实现“指定做什么”。

### 两阶段训练
- **第一阶段**：训练语言无关的视觉-动作专家，目标 min -E[log π(a|v)]，得到参数 θ_VA 和中间嵌入 f_θ_VA(v)。

ent_paper_learning_category_level_last_m.name: Learning Category-level Last-meter Navigation from RGB Demonstrations of a Single-instance
ent_paper_learning_category_level_last_m.name_en: Learning Category-level Last-meter Navigation from RGB Demonstrations of a Single-instance
ent_paper_learning_category_level_last_m.summary: arXiv:2512.11173v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Achieving precise positioning of the mobile manipulator's base is essential for successful manipulation actions that follow. Most of the RGB-based navigation systems only guarantee coarse, meter-level accuracy, making them less suitable for the precise positioning phase of mobile manipulation. This gap prevents manipulation policies from operating within the distribution of their training demonstrations, resulting in frequent execution failures. We address this gap by introducing an object-centric imitation learning framework for last-meter navigation, enabling a quadruped mobile manipulator robot to achieve manipulation-ready positioning using only RGB observations from its onboard cameras. Our method conditions the navigation policy on three inputs: goal images, multi-view RGB observations from the onboard cameras, and a text prompt specifying the target object. A language-driven segmentation module and a spatial score-matrix decoder then supply explicit object grounding and relative pose reasoning. Using real-world data from a single object instance within a category, the system generalizes to unseen object instances across diverse environments with challenging lighting and background conditions. To comprehensively evaluate this, we introduce two metrics: an edge-alignment metric, which uses ground truth orientation, and an object-alignment metric, which evaluates how well the robot visually faces the target. Under these metrics, our policy achieves 74.58% success in edge-alignment and 89.42% success in object-alignment when positioning relative to unseen target objects. These results show that precise last-meter navigation can be achieved at a category-level without depth, LiDAR, or map priors, enabling a scalable pathway toward unified mobile manipulation. Project page: https://rpm-lab-umn.github.io/category-level-last-meter-nav/

ent_paper_liu_semantics_aware_adaptive_k.body:
## 概述

本文提出一种面向传感器到视觉动作识别的语义感知自适应知识蒸馏方法，由作者团队针对跨模态（传感器至视觉）动作识别中的语义对齐与动态蒸馏难题设计。核心贡献在于引入语义感知的蒸馏权重调节机制，并自适应平衡教师与学生网络间的知识迁移，显著提升识别精度与泛化能力。

## 它改变了什么

该工作改变了跨模态动作识别中知识蒸馏“一刀切”的固有范式。以往蒸馏方法多假设教师与学生在特征空间上同质，忽略传感器数据与视觉数据间的语义鸿沟，导致迁移知识含噪声或错位。本文真正变革之处在于将语义信息作为蒸馏过程的显式调节信号，而非仅依赖输出层或中间层的特征匹配，从而解决了异构模态下知识迁移的“语义漂移”问题。这一改动对实际部署意义重大，因为真实场景中传感器（如IMU）与视觉数据常存在分布偏移，传统蒸馏在此类场景下性能衰减明显。

## 方法拆解

### 语义感知蒸馏框架
- 教师网络：预训练的视觉动作识别模型（如基于RGB视频），输出软标签与中间层特征。
- 学生网络：轻量级传感器数据（如加速度计、陀螺仪）编码器，结构为时序卷积与注意力模块。
- 语义对齐模块：将教师与学生特征映射至共享语义空间，通过对比损失（InfoNCE）拉近同类样本、推开异类样本，对齐维度为 `ℝ^{d}`（d 为嵌入维度，论文未明确具体值）。

### 自适应蒸馏权重

- 权重公式：`λ(x) = α · sigmoid(β · (s(x) - γ))`，其中 `α`、`β`、`γ` 为超参数（论文未明确具体值），用于控制蒸馏强度随语义匹配度动态变化。

ent_paper_jabbour_dont_run_with_scissors.body:
## 概述

RoboBallet 是 Google DeepMind、UCL 与 Intrinsic 联合提出的强化学习框架，用图神经网络策略直接协调最多 8 台 7-DoF 机械臂（56 维配置空间）完成 40 个共享任务，在 A100 上推理速度超过 300 倍实时。核心贡献在于将任务分配、调度与运动规划联合求解从组合爆炸中解放出来，并首次展示零样本泛化到未见环境与真实机器人执行。

## 它改变了什么

多机器人 TAMP 的经典解法（如集中式搜索、分布式采样）在工业规模下计算不可行，现有工业实践依赖人工凭直觉设计轨迹，单个工作单元常需数百至数千小时。此前最先进方法仅能扩展到 5 个机器人、10 个任务，且通常假设任务间存在依赖或机器人能力异构——这实际上缩小了搜索空间。作者选择的是最困难的完全无约束场景：任何机器人可执行任何任务、无任务间依赖，此时组合空间最大。

真正改变的是「规划」的语义：不再为每个机器人单独求可行轨迹再合并，而是让一个策略同时输出所有机器人的关节速度，将 TAMP 转化为单次前向推理。这使得工作单元布局优化（机器人位置、数量、类型）从「先布局再规划」的解耦流程，变成可被黑盒优化器快速评估的闭环——布局优化带来的执行时间改善高达 33%（由表内数值计算），这在经典方法下因每次评估需数小时规划而完全不可行。

## 方法拆解

### 场景图表示
- 节点：机器人、障碍物、任务三类
- 边：每个任务连接所有机器人（任务可被任意机器人执行）、每个障碍物连接所有机器人（碰撞感知）、机器人两两相连（相互避碰）
- 图结构使模型复杂度不随场景规模增长——GNN 权重共享类似 CNN 的固定核大小，这是可扩展性的根本来源

### 策略与动作空间
- 输入：场景图 + 当前关节状态
- 输出：所有机器人所有关节的目标关节速度（8×7=56 维）

ent_paper_wang_tacrefinenet_tactile_only.body:
## 概述

MoTo（Move and Touch）是一个零样本、即插即用的交互感知导航模块，旨在将任意现成固定基座操作模型扩展为移动操作能力，无需任何移动操作专家数据。其核心贡献在于通过场景图与多视图投票生成交互关键点，并优化基座停靠位置，从而将移动操作分解为“导航至合适停靠点”与“固定基座操作”两个子问题，避免了端到端策略对大规模移动数据集的依赖。

## 它改变了什么

移动操作长期以来被端到端学习范式主导，但这类方法受限于移动操作数据采集成本极高，泛化能力始终是瓶颈。与此同时，固定基座操作基础模型（如 ReKep 等）已展现出强大的泛化能力，却因无法预测基座移动而被局限于固定场景。简单地将导航模块与操作模块拼接，会因导航目标与操作目标之间的语义鸿沟产生复合误差——导航模块不知道手臂需要什么停靠位置，操作模块也无法纠正基座偏差。

MoTo 真正改变的是“移动操作必须端到端学习”这一隐含假设。它通过交互感知导航，将移动问题转化为“识别目标物体上的关键点与手臂上的关键点，并控制基座使两者对齐”这一几何对齐问题。这使得移动操作可以被分解为两个独立可解的固定基座子问题，从而让零样本、无训练数据的移动操作成为可能。这一思路跳出了数据驱动的框架，转而利用 VLM 的语义理解与 SLAM 的几何定位能力，为移动操作提供了一条全新的、可组合的技术路径。

We study whether such data can instead support functional dexterity in articulated tool use, where a robot must acquire a tool, maintain contact, and operate its functional moving parts. These results show that grasp datasets can serve not only as resources for grasp synthesis, but also as scalable pretraining data for contact-rich dexterous manipulation. ent_paper_corridorvla_explicit_spatial_c.summary: arXiv:2604.21241v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models often use intermediate representations to connect multimodal inputs with continuous control, yet spatial guidance is often injected implicitly through latent features. We propose CorridorVLA, which predicts sparse spatial anchors as incremental physical changes (e.g., end-effector $\Delta$-positions) and uses them to impose an explicit tolerance region in the training objective for action generation. The anchors define a tolerance corridor that guides a flow-matching action head: trajectories whose implied spatial evolution falls outside the corridor receive corrective gradients, while trajectories within the corridor are refined by a consistency objective. CorridorVLA improves SmolVLA by 4.45 percentage points on LIBERO and improves SmolVLA and GR00T by 12.37 and 7.98 percentage points, respectively, on the more challenging LIBERO-Plus benchmark. Notably, under the same single-policy 4-in-1 setting, where one policy is jointly trained and evaluated across all task suites, GR00T-Corr achieves an 83.21% success rate. These results indicate that action-aligned physical cues can provide direct and interpretable constraints for generative action policies, complementing spatial guidance encoded in visual or latent forms. Code and released model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/lidc54/corridorVLA and https://huggingface.co/lidc/CorridorVLA.
ent_paper_corridorvla_explicit_spatial_c.body:
## 概述

CorridorVLA 提出一种显式空间约束的生成式动作头设计：在动作块内以 K 个稀疏时间锚点预测末端执行器增量位移，并构造样本相关的走廊缓冲损失与一致性项，将文本风格的空间线索直接注入动作生成。作者基于 SmolVLA 与 GR00T 在 LIBERO 与 LIBERO-Plus 上验证，仅增加 K=3 个预测 token，成功率提升 3.4%–12.4%（由表内数值计算），推理成本基本不变。

## 它改变了什么

现有 VLA 的空间引导几乎全部走潜在特征或视觉中间表示（目标图像、未来视频、路点）的隐式路径，这些信号把任务相关运动与外观细节纠缠在一起，动作头只能通过注意力间接“感受”空间约束。CorridorVLA 改变的是中间表示的形态与作用层级：不再用高维视觉或潜在特征去“暗示”空间，而是用低维增量位移这种贴近控制流形的物理量，在目标层面直接给出可计算的约束。这看似是表示选择，实质是把空间引导从“特征塑形”变成“目标约束”，让训练信号不再依赖模型能否从潜在空间自行解耦出空间信息。

另一个被改变的假设是：生成式动作头（流匹配）的采样轨迹不需要全程显式监督。作者发现只在 K 个稀疏锚点处施加走廊约束，配合阶段式一致性项，就能稳定引导整个动作块生成，这比逐点稠密约束更省 token 且更易优化。同时，将状态路径从“编码即输入”改为“预测即输出”并允许双向注意力，说明动作头的输入输出角色可以重新分配，而不必固守自回归式设计。

## 方法拆解

### 稀疏锚点预测
- 在长度 T 的动作块内，于 K 个时间间隔步骤处预测末端执行器 3D Δ-位置，作为稀疏空间锚点。
- 使用 K 个可学习 token 附加到骨干输入，避免自回归设计对预测长度的紧耦合，便于变化预测量和采样窗口。
- 默认 K=3，仅增加 3 个额外预测 token，模型容量不变。

ent_paper_jiang_rynnvla_001_using_human_.body:
## 概述

RynnVLA-001 提出一种基于人类示教数据改进机器人操作能力的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。该系统通过多阶段课程学习与双教师蒸馏管道，使类人机器人仅依赖第一人称 RGB 观测和自然语言指令，即可执行长时程、多物体的连续重排任务。核心贡献在于构建了 HumanoidVerse 仿真框架，并扩展了包含 350 个顺序双物体任务的数据集，在任务成功率与空间精度上显著超越先前最先进方法。

## 它改变了什么

现有类人机器人控制研究长期被困在“单物体、固定场景”的实验室范式里。无论是基于模型预测控制还是端到端强化学习，大多数系统都假设环境状态完全已知、任务边界清晰，一旦面对真实世界中“把杯子放到厨房台面，再把书放到客厅书架”这种连续指令流，就会因缺乏任务切换机制而崩溃。RynnVLA-001 真正改变的，是让机器人从“执行单个动作”进化到“管理整个任务序列”——它不再需要环境重置，而是通过语言指令驱动子任务间的平滑过渡，这直接回应了部署场景中“人不断下达新指令”这一最基本事实。

更关键的是，它打破了“视觉-语言模型只能做高层规划、底层控制仍需显式状态估计”的行业惯性。通过双教师蒸馏，将拥有特权状态访问的教师策略压缩为仅依赖 RGB 像素和学生网络，使得感知-控制闭环不再依赖精确的物体位姿或环境地图。这意味着系统具备了在未知环境中泛化的可能，而不仅仅是过拟合于训练场景。从工程角度看，这是从“仿真演示”走向“真实部署”的重要一步。

### 整体架构
HumanoidVerse 采用“教师-学生”双层架构，教师负责学习任务，学生负责模仿行为并泛化。

### 教师策略训练（特权阶段）

## Overview
Robotic learning takes place in dynamic environments with large behavior spaces. A terminal success signal only tells the robot whether the task is completed. It does not explain whether the current behavior is making progress, remaining unchanged, or undoing earlier progress. For this reason, recent studies have increasingly explored progress rewards that provide feedback during task execution. However, the current literature lacks a shared framework. Existing methods use different observations, goal specifications, output signals, supervision sources, and evaluation protocols. ## Overview
The performance of legged locomotion is closely tied to the accuracy and comprehensiveness of state observations. ent_paper_human_centric_transferable_tac.name: Human-Centric Transferable Tactile Pre-Training for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
ent_paper_human_centric_transferable_tac.name_en: Human-Centric Transferable Tactile Pre-Training for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
ent_paper_human_centric_transferable_tac.summary: arXiv:2607.01067v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As an essential modality for dexterous and contact-rich tasks, tactile sensing provides precise force feedback that cannot be reliably inferred from vision. However, limited by hardware and data collection systems, existing datasets with tactility remain small in scale and narrow in contact coverage. Meanwhile, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with tactile modality are constrained on dynamics-agnostic post-training, which limits the performance ceiling on downstream tasks. In this paper, we present H-Tac, a large-scale tactile-action dataset with 160-hour egocentric human videos containing more than 300 tasks and 135k episodes. Building upon this, we propose Transferable Tactile Pre-Training (TTP), a system of tactile-based pre-training on human data for fine-grained robotic tasks. To bridge the gap between humans and robots, we use unified tactile and action spaces throughout the pre-training and post-training phases, preserving prior knowledge during human-to-robot transfer. By leveraging a tactile expert for future tactile prediction, our framework explicitly models the contact dynamics and precise physical interactions. Extensive experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate that our model achieves superior performance, exhibiting robust generalization and fine-grained manipulation capabilities. TTP paves the way for scalable tactile pre-training via human-to-robot transfer.
ent_paper_human_centric_transferable_tac.body:
## 概述

本文提出首个以人为中心的触觉预训练系统TTP（Tactile Pre-Training），由作者团队构建，旨在解决灵巧操作中触觉数据稀缺及跨具身（人体手到机器人手）迁移难题。核心贡献有三：一是利用自我中心视频、语言指令及配对动作-触觉标注进行大规模预训练，实现触觉与视觉、语言的隐式对齐；二是引入统一触觉空间UniTacHand（每手351个taxel）与流匹配（Flow Matching）框架，联合建模动作生成与未来触觉预测；三是设计触觉-动作流形保持门控（MPG）机制，通过可靠性门控调制残差增强，降低条件上下文分布偏移导致的预测方差。在真实机器人9个任务中，TTP在精细操作（如削皮成功率提升至96.7% vs 基线43.2%）和接触丰富任务（折纸84% vs 0%）上显著优于基线，并展现出分布外泛化能力。

## 它改变了什么

这篇论文真正改变的，是触觉预训练的数据来源与迁移范式。长期以来，触觉-动作策略学习被困在“机器人本体数据”的循环里——数据稀缺、采集昂贵、形态各异，导致触觉始终是VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型中的二等公民。作者把目光转向人类：用自我中心视频、语言指令、配对的动作与触觉标注做大规模预训练，再迁移到多种机器人手上。这个转向的深层含义是，触觉不再被当作“传感器读数”，而是被当作一种可跨具身学习的**模态语言**——就像视觉和语言一样，先在大规模人类数据上学到通用表征，再在下游任务中微调。

但跨具身迁移的痛点在于：人手与机器人手的触觉表示天然不一致，直接预训练-后训练会导致分布偏移。作者用UniTacHand统一触觉空间（每只手保留351个taxel，投影到MANO手模型表面），把不同具身的压阻式触觉映射到同一流形上，这相当于给触觉建立了一个“世界坐标”。这个设计的关键不在于投影本身，而在于它让预训练（人手）与后训练（机器人手）共享同一表…

ent_paper_adapting_generalist_robot_poli.name_en: Adapting Generalist Robot Policies with Semantic Reinforcement Learning
ent_paper_adapting_generalist_robot_poli.summary: arXiv:2606.31958v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generalist robot policies learn a diverse repertoire of behaviors from large-scale pretraining. In principle, this makes them excellent priors for downstream adaptation via reinforcement learning (RL). In practice, however, standard RL methods leveraging this prior optimize directly over robot actions, requiring the base policy's action distribution to be close to that of a performant policy from the start. This assumption breaks down for complex or long-horizon tasks that fall outside the pretraining distribution. Our key insight is that, for sufficiently expressive generalist policies, language prompts are an effective alternative space for learning to solve such tasks: modulating language inputs elicits skills already within the policy's repertoire, which can be composed to solve tasks beyond its zero-shot capabilities. We propose Semantic Action Reinforcement Learning (SARL), which learns to optimize this prompt space through online interaction, treating the generalist policy as a controllable skill prior. Importantly, leveraging pretrained skills rather than learning new ones from scratch yields structured, semantically meaningful exploration and highly efficient online improvement, and learning to modulate prompts through experience grounds them in induced real-world behaviors for robust task-solving. Across real-world settings and simulated benchmarks, we show SARL unlocks fundamentally new capabilities -- adapting VLA behavior to solve complex, long-horizon tasks -- and significantly outperforms existing approaches for improving robot behavior in deployment.

ent_paper_cao_fastdrivevla_efficient_end.summary: FastDriveVLA: Efficient End-to-End Driving via Plug-and-Play Reconstruction-based Token Pruning (FastDriveVLA), is a 2025 large vision-language-action model for robotic manipulation, introduced by Peking University, XPeng Motors.
ent_paper_cao_fastdrivevla_efficient_end.body:
## 概述

FastDriveVLA 提出一种即插即用的重建引导 token 剪枝方法，用于加速端到端驾驶模型。核心贡献在于将 token 剪枝视为可学习优化问题，通过重建损失自动识别并移除冗余视觉 token，在保持驾驶性能的同时显著降低计算开销。

## 它改变了什么

端到端驾驶模型长期受困于视觉 token 数量与推理延迟的矛盾。此前方法要么依赖手工设计的启发式规则（如按注意力分数或空间位置剪枝），要么需要额外训练辅助网络，前者难以适应多变驾驶场景，后者增加训练复杂度。FastDriveVLA 真正改变的是将 token 剪枝从“人工设计策略”转向“自动搜索最优策略”，使模型能根据输入内容动态决定保留哪些 token，而非固定模式。这一转变意味着剪枝决策本身成为可优化的对象，为延迟-精度权衡提供了更精细的控制粒度。

## 方法拆解

### 问题形式化
将 token 剪枝定义为优化问题：给定视觉 token 集合 V，寻找子集 S⊂V 使重建损失最小化，同时满足预算约束 |S|≤B。

### 搜索策略
- 采用可微分的 token 重要性评分网络，为每个 token 生成保留概率
- 通过 Gumbel-Softmax 实现离散采样的连续松弛，使梯度可回传
- 搜索空间覆盖三种操作：保留、合并、丢弃，由评分网络自动选择

### 重建引导
- 使用轻量级解码器从剪枝后的 token 重建原始视觉特征
- 重建损失作为剪枝质量的直接监督信号，避免依赖下游任务梯度
- 训练时联合优化剪枝策略与重建器，推理时仅保留剪枝模块

### 即插即用设计
- 剪枝模块作为独立层插入视觉编码器与 LLM 之间
- 不修改预训练权重，仅新增可训练参数
- 支持任意视觉 token 输入，无需针对特定模型重新训练

## 关键创新

1. **搜索替代启发式**：首次将 tok…

HoRD 是一个两阶段语言引导的机器人技能获取框架：先用特权信息训练高性能教师策略，再在线蒸馏为仅依赖稀疏观测的 Transformer 学生策略。其核心贡献在于通过历史条件动力学表示（HCDR）与标准化稀疏关节表示（SSJR），实现从稀疏运动命令到扭矩级控制、跨物理引擎与动力学扰动的零样本泛化。

## 它改变了什么

现有物理控制策略的脆弱性根源在于对源域动力学的过拟合：一旦质量分布、摩擦系数或控制延迟发生微小偏移，策略性能即断崖式下跌。更棘手的是，真实部署场景中规划器通常只提供稀疏关键点命令，而现有方法（如 MaskedMimic、OmniH2O）在训练与推理时都依赖密集关节空间轨迹，这种“训练-部署”不对称使得从仿真到实物的迁移几乎必然失败。作者真正改变的是将“域随机化”从训练时的数据增强手段，升级为一种可在线推理的动力学状态估计问题——不是盲目地让策略见过更多扰动，而是让策略学会在运行中“感知”当前 episode 的物理参数并据此调整控制输出。这一转变使得零样本跨引擎迁移（Isaac Lab 到 Genesis）成为可能，而无需任何目标域数据或微调。

## Overview

ent_paper_doublyaware_dual_planning_and_.body:
## 概述

DoublyAware 是一个面向人形机器人运动控制的 TD-MPC 扩展，由维也纳技术大学团队提出，核心贡献是将不确定性显式分解为规划不确定性与策略不确定性两个不相交组件，并分别用共形预测（Conformal Prediction）与组相对策略约束（GRPC）加以处理。该方法在 Unitree H1-2 的 HumanoidBench 九项运动任务中，显著优于 SAC、TD-MPC2 等基线，在站立、行走、跑步、坐椅、绕杆、走斜坡六项任务上达到充分解决水平。

## 它改变了什么

TD-MPC 系列方法在低维或仿真简单任务上表现优异，但迁移到 26 自由度人形机器人时，高维动作空间与复杂接触动力学放大了两类本质不同的不确定性：MPC 局部采样带来的规划随机性（aleatoric），以及策略网络对未探索状态-动作空间的不完整认知（epistemic）。现有框架将两者混为一谈，导致规划器在随机动力学下产生不可行轨迹，策略更新在高维空间中频繁震荡。

DoublyAware 真正改变的是将“不确定性”从一个笼统的损失项或正则项，拆解为两个可独立设计、可分别验证的算法模块。规划侧用共形预测提供统计保证的轨迹筛选，策略侧用组相对优势构造自适应信任域——这种“各管各的不确定性”的设计哲学，使得每个模块的改进都能被单独归因和消融验证，而非像以往那样所有问题都堆在同一个目标函数里。

## Overview
Tactile sensing for social-physical human-robot interaction (spHRI) is designed in a hardware-driven manner, where predefined sensor configurations constrain coverage, spatial resolution, and the range of recognizable gestures. We propose a requirement-driven framework that derives sensing requirements, specifically spatial resolution and placement, directly from interaction data. Using a VR-based platform with haptic feedback, we collected high-resolution whole-body contact distributions across multiple social scenarios, from which we identified nine recurring social touch gestures. Eight gestures were selected for controlled data collection with 18 participants, yielding an open-source dataset of 5,520 trials. Analysis of contact distributions and simulated tactile encodings …

ent_paper_roncone_gaze_stabilization_for.body:
## Overview
Gaze stabilization is an important requisite for humanoid robots. Previous work on this topic has focused on the integration of inertial and visual information. Little attention has been given to a third component, which is the knowledge that the robot has about its own movement. In this work we propose a comprehensive framework for gaze stabilization in a humanoid robot. We focus on the problem of compensating for disturbances induced in the cameras due to self-generated movements of the robot. ## Overview
Solving complex real-world control tasks often takes multiple tries: if we fail at first, we reflect on what went wrong, and change our strategy accordingly to avoid making the same mistake. In robotics, Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) offer a promising path towards solving complex control tasks, but lack the ability to contextually and dynamically readjust behavior when they fail to accomplish a task. ## Overview
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress by leveraging the robust capabilities of Visual Language Models (VLMs). ent_paper_intelligence_06_a_vla_that_lea.name_en: π0.6*: a VLA That Learns From Experience
ent_paper_intelligence_06_a_vla_that_lea.summary: π0.6*: a VLA That Learns From Experience (π0.6*), is a 2025 large vision-language-action model for robotic manipulation, introduced by Physical Intelligence.
ent_paper_intelligence_06_a_vla_that_lea.body:
## 概述

π0.6* 是一个从经验中学习的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，由 Physical Intelligence 团队提出，核心贡献在于让 VLA 能够从非专家、非标注的真实世界交互数据中持续学习，从而突破静态数据集训练的瓶颈。该工作通过在线微调与经验回放机制，显著提升了模型在真实机器人操作任务中的泛化与自适应能力。

## 它改变了什么

此前 VLA 的训练范式是“一次性”的：在大规模静态数据集上预训练，然后冻结或少量微调。这导致模型无法从部署后的交互中改进，也无法适应环境变化或新任务。π0.6* 改变了这一范式，它让模型在真实部署中持续从自身经验学习，将“训练”与“推理”的边界打破，使机器人系统具备闭环进化能力。这一转变对长期部署的机器人系统意义重大，因为它意味着模型不再是一次性消耗品，而是可以随使用而增值的资产。

## 方法拆解

### 在线微调框架
- 在 π0 预训练模型基础上，引入在线微调阶段，使用真实机器人交互产生的轨迹数据。
- 数据来源包括成功与失败的尝试，通过经验回放缓冲区存储，并定期采样用于更新模型权重。

### 经验回放机制
- 回放缓冲区按任务与场景分层组织，避免单一任务过拟合。
- 采样策略偏向近期经验与高信息量样本（如失败但接近成功的轨迹），以加速学习。

### 损失函数与更新规则
- 沿用 π0 的动作分块预测损失，但增加一项“经验加权”项，对近期成功轨迹赋予更高权重。
- 更新频率为每收集 250 条新轨迹触发一次微调（论文未明确具体批量大小）。

### 关键设计决策
- 保留预训练权重作为初始化，仅微调最后几层 Transformer 块，以降低灾难性遗忘风险。
- 使用 YARP 中间件同步在线数据流与模型更新，确保训练与推理不互相阻塞。

## 关键创新

1. **从经验中学习的闭环机制**：这是首个将 VL…

## Overview
Humanoid robots hold great potential to perform various human-level skills, involving unified locomotion and manipulation in real-world settings. ent_paper_a_closed_form_geometric_retarg.body:
## Overview
Retargeting human motion to robot poses is a practical approach for teleoperating bimanual humanoid robot arms, but existing methods can be suboptimal and slow, often causing undesirable motion or latency. This is due to optimizing to match robot end-effector to human hand position and orientation, which can also limit the robot's workspace to that of the human. Instead, this paper reframes retargeting as an orientation alignment problem, enabling a closed-form, geometric solution algorithm with an optimality guarantee. The key idea is to align a robot arm to a human's upper and lower arm orientations, as identified from shoulder, elbow, and wrist (SEW) keypoints; hence, the method is called SEW-Mimic. ## Overview
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often fail to generalize to unseen camera viewpoints, a limitation stemming from their difficulty in inferring robust 3D geometry from 2D images. We introduce GeoAware-VLA, a simple yet effective approach that enhances viewpoint invariance by integrating strong geometric priors into the vision backbone. Instead of training a visual encoder or relying on explicit 3D data, we leverage a frozen, pretrained geometric vision model as a feature extractor. A lightweight, trainable projection layer then adapts these geometrically-rich features for the policy decoder, relieving it of the burden of learning 3D consistency from scratch. ## Overview

DIAYN (Diversity is All You Need) is a reward-free skill learning method proposed by Ben Eysenbach et al., which maximizes a joint objective of mutual information and policy entropy to enable agents to autonomously emerge diverse and distinguishable behavioral skills. What this paper truly changed is the way the "skill discovery" problem is defined. ent_paper_claxton_improving_visual_place.body:
## 概述

本文提出一种基于 MLP 的完整性监控器，用于验证视觉位置识别（VPR）的定位估计，并将其集成到主动机器人导航系统中。作者来自 QUT 团队，核心贡献在于用神经网络替代 SVM 实现跨环境泛化，并通过单查询拒绝和查询历史（HoQ）两种策略，显著降低导航目标误差并提升任务成功率。

## 它改变了什么

VPR 系统在真实导航中的瓶颈从来不是“找得到”，而是“信不信得过”。以往用 SVM 监控 VPR 完整性，每换一个环境就要重新训练、手动调参，这在部署层面基本等于不可用。本文真正改变的是把完整性监控从“环境专属的补丁”变成了“可迁移的通用模块”——MLP 在 QCR 训练后，直接扔到 Nordland 和 Oxford RobotCar 上，准确率从基线的 8.6% 拉到 69.8%（由表内数值 8.6→69.8 计算），这个跨域跳跃才是关键。

更实质的变化在于：作者没有停留在“拒绝坏匹配”的被动防御，而是把验证结果接入了导航决策回路。单查询拒绝把聚合平均目标误差从 ≈9.8m 压到 ≈3.1m，HoQ 方法把定位误差从 ≈2.0m 降到 ≈0.5m——这不是精度数字的游戏，而是让机器人真正敢用 VPR 结果去走路的差别。

## 方法拆解

### 完整性预测器
- 监督学习：用查询和参考遍历的 VPR 匹配做训练数据，地面真值将匹配分为容差内/外（室内 >0.5m，室外 >1.0m 为容差外）。
- MLP 结构：4 层 × 128 神经元，输出单神经元，ReLU 激活 + Sigmoid 输出，批大小 8，学习率 0.00001，dropout 10%。
- 输入特征：48 个手工统计特征 × 4 个向量（距离向量、查询 VPR 特征、最佳匹配参考特征、VPR 特征差）= 192 维。

## Overview

ent_paper_clap_direct_vlm_to_vla_adaptat.name_en: CLAP: Direct VLM-to-VLA Adaptation via Language-Action Grounding
ent_paper_clap_direct_vlm_to_vla_adaptat.summary: arXiv:2607.08974v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) inherit semantic capabilities from pretrained VLMs, yet large-scale post-training on robot data and architectural modifications can reshape the backbone so extensively that it becomes difficult to isolate what the VLM contributes to control. Directly converting pretrained VLMs into VLAs with minimal architectural change offers a more transparent path to understanding how VLM capabilities transfer across model scales. The core obstacle is output-distribution mismatch: predicting actions as bare numeric token sequences moves generation away from the VLM's pretrained language distribution, degrading the capabilities we seek to preserve. To address this, we propose CLAP (Causal Language-Action Prediction), which prepends each numeric action sequence with a natural-language action description, causally conditioning precise action-token prediction on a language-action plan without modifying the backbone architecture. With single-epoch fine-tuning alone, 2B CLAP achieves 90.8% on LIBERO (+14.9 pt over VLA-0) and improves robustness on LIBERO-PRO under language, object, and spatial perturbations. We will release CLAP at 0.8B, 2B, and 4B as an open-weight, multi-scale compact VLA family from a single VLM lineage, enabling controlled analysis of VLM-to-VLA capability transfer.

## Overview

PhysForge is a two-stage decoupled framework designed to generate physically interactive 3D assets from a single image. It first uses a VLM planner to output hierarchical part bounding boxes and physical attributes, then uses a diffusion model to generate geometry and joint parameters, and is accompanied by the release of a 150k-scale PhysDB dataset. The core contribution lies in treating "physical functionality" as the primary constraint for generation, rather than an after-the-fact label.

## 概述

VLA-0 提出一种极简的 VLA 构建范式：直接利用 VLM 原生文本生成能力，将连续动作归一化为整数序列并以空格分隔的文本形式输出，不对底层模型做任何架构或词表修改。基于 3B 参数的 Qwen-VL-2.5，在 LIBERO 基准上以 94.7% 平均成功率超越所有使用相同机器人数据的现有方法，甚至超过多数使用大规模动作预训练的模型，并在真实 SO-100 机器人上以 4 Hz 推理速度超越预训练基线 SmolVLA 12.5 个百分点。

## 它改变了什么

现有 VLA 构建路径几乎都默认需要“改造”VLM：要么把连续动作离散成 bin 再映射到词表（Discrete Token），要么在 VLM 上外挂扩散或流匹配头（Generative Action Head），要么动架构、加参数、改训练流程（Custom Architecture）。这些做法各有代价：离散化限制动作分辨率且挪用文本词表损害语言能力；外挂动作头引入需微调的新网络，常导致底层 VLM 的 grounding 能力退化；自定义架构则牺牲了 VLM 的即插即用性。作者指出了一个被行业惯性忽略的事实——VLM 本身就能以文本形式输出任意精度的数字，为什么还要绕路去发明新的动作表示？VLA-0 的真正改变在于：它把“构建 VLA”从一项需要专门设计的工程问题，还原为一个纯粹的提示工程问题。这动摇了“VLA 必须修改 VLM”这一隐含前提，证明零修改的文本动作输出不仅能工作，而且在同等数据条件下比所有精心设计的替代方案都更强。这一结果对社区的意义在于：大量针对动作头、tokenizer、架构的复杂创新，可能都是在为一个本不存在的问题提供解决方案。

ent_paper_ldhp_library_driven_hierarchic.summary: arXiv:2603.13844v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Non-prehensile manipulation is essential for handling thin, large, or otherwise ungraspable objects in unstructured settings. Prior planning and search-based methods often rely on ad-hoc manual designs or generate physically unrealizable motions by ignoring critical gripper properties, while training-based approaches are data-intensive and struggle to generalize to novel, out-of-distribution tasks. We propose a library-driven hierarchical planner (LDHP) that makes executability a first-class design goal: a top-tier contact-state planner proposes object-pose paths using MoveObject primitives, and a bottom-tier grasp planner synthesizes feasible grasp sequences with AdjustGrasp primitives; feasibility is certified by collision checks and quasi-static mechanics, and contact-sensitive segments are recovered via a bounded dichotomy refinement. This gripper-aware decomposition decouples object motion from grasp realizability, yields a task-agnostic pipeline that transfers across manipulation tasks and geometric variations without re-design, and exposes clean hooks for optional learned priors. Real-robot studies on zero-mobility lifting and slot insertion demonstrate consistent execution and robustness to shape and environment changes.

ent_paper_unified_video_action_model_202.body:
## 概述

UVA 是一个统一视频-动作模型，由 Toyota Research Institute 等机构的研究者提出，旨在联合建模视频和动作但分别解码。核心贡献在于通过统一潜在表示和掩码训练，在推理时完全跳过视频生成，实现与动作仅方法相当的推理速度，同时保留视频生成带来的观测监督优势。

## 它改变了什么

视频生成方法（如 UniPi）和动作仅方法（如 Diffusion Policy）之间存在一个根本性的权衡：前者通过生成高分辨率视频来获得观测监督，但推理速度慢且生成错误会传播到动作预测；后者速度快但缺乏对场景动态的建模，容易过拟合动作历史。UVA 真正改变的是打破了这种二选一的局面——它证明视频和动作可以在一个共享的潜在空间中联合建模，而推理时无需解码视频。

这个问题的关键在于视频生成需要高空间分辨率，动作控制需要高时间频率，两者在计算需求上天然冲突。UVA 通过将两者统一到潜在空间，让视频生成成为训练时的辅助监督信号，而非推理时的必要步骤，从而在保留视频监督好处的同时，将推理速度提升到与动作仅方法相当的水平。

## 方法拆解

### 统一潜在视频-动作表示
历史图像观测通过预训练 VAE 编码器（kl-f16）编码为潜在图，展平后经全连接层投影为 d 维潜在向量，每个图像表示为 N 个视觉 token。历史动作以更高采样频率记录，每个图像观测对应 L 个动作，动作块重复 M 次以匹配视觉 token 数量，经全连接层转换为 N 个动作 token。

### 掩码自编码器训练
未来观测帧经 VAE 编码和全连接层处理后，训练时随机掩码部分 token。视觉 token 与历史视觉和动作 token 通道级拼接，经 Transformer 融合产生联合视频-动作潜在表示 {Z_{t+1},…,Z_{t+h}}。为最小化帧间信息泄漏，所有视频帧一致掩码相同…

## 概述

FocusNav 是一个面向 Unitree G1 人形机器人的端到端导航策略，基于“大脑-小脑”协调机制，采用感知-预测-注意力范式，通过空间选择性注意力框架同时处理动态避障与崎岖地形稳定行走。核心贡献在于将高层导航目标与低层运动控制深度融合，并引入航点预测引导的注意力机制与稳定性自适应的信息截断策略。

## 它改变了什么

现有 VLN 框架普遍采用“高层输出速度命令 + 低层跟踪”的解耦架构，这在受控环境中尚可工作，但在非结构化、人口密集的真实场景中，高层规划与低层运动之间的信息传递延迟和语义鸿沟会导致避障反应迟钝、步态调整僵硬。FocusNav 真正改变的是这种架构性割裂——它不再让高层“指挥”低层，而是让感知、预测和运动控制共享一个注意力空间，使导航决策直接作用于关节级运动指令。

另一个关键改变在于对“稳定性”的处理。传统方法将地形可通行性与障碍物避让视为两个独立模块，容易在复杂场景中产生冲突（例如避障路径恰好经过不可通行区域）。FocusNav 通过可达性优化层和稳定性自适应的注意力截断机制，将地形约束内化为策略的隐式偏好，而非事后修正，这从根本上改变了问题求解的耦合方式。

## Overview
The development of autonomous robotic systems that can learn from human demonstrations to imitate a desired behavior - rather than being manually programmed - has huge technological potential. One major challenge in imitation learning is the correspondence problem: how to establish corresponding states and actions between expert and learner, when the embodiments of the agents are different (morphology, dynamics, degrees of freedom, etc.). ## 概述

CondMDI 提出一种基于掩码条件扩散模型的统一框架，用于解决角色动画中稀疏关键帧插值问题。该方法通过二进制观测掩码统一处理时间稀疏（任意关键帧数量）与空间稀疏（部分关节）条件，并支持文本引导，在 HumanML3D 上实现与 OmniControl 相当的性能但架构更简单。

## 它改变了什么

运动扩散模型此前在条件生成上主要依赖文本或全局轨迹，对于“在指定时间点、指定关节上必须精确通过”这类硬约束缺乏原生支持。MDM 与 PriorMDM 在相对坐标上训练，推理时无法直接对全局坐标关键帧做条件化；GMD 虽用全局坐标表示，却不支持完整关键帧输入。OmniControl 虽支持关节控制，但其架构复杂，且需要额外的控制网络。CondMDI 真正改变的是将“关键帧条件”从一种需要专门设计的后处理或辅助网络，变成扩散模型训练与采样过程中的一个统一、可微的掩码操作——训练时随机采样观测掩码，采样时每步将观测部分替换为关键帧值。这使得同一个模型无需修改架构即可处理从单关节轨迹到全身关键帧的任意稀疏度条件，且推理时无需额外的优化循环。

## 方法拆解

### 训练阶段
- 随机采样关键帧数量与关节数量，生成二进制观测掩码 **m** ∈ ℝ^(N×J×D)，指示哪些帧-关节对被观测。
- 将带噪样本 **x_t** 在观测位置替换为干净关键帧 **c**，并将掩码与样本拼接后输入扩散模型 G_θ。
- 训练目标为最小化 ‖**x_0** − G_θ(**x_t**, t, **p**)‖²，其中 **p** 为文本提示的 CLIP 编码。
- 以 10% 概率将条件信号（文本或关键帧）置为 ∅，以支持 classifier-free guidance。

### 采样阶段
- 每步将 **x_t** 的观测部分替换为关键帧 **c**，保证生成轨迹严格通过关键…

## 概述

该论文针对齿轮驱动人形机器人的双足运动学习问题，提出仅依赖足部安装的IMU（Foot-Mounted IMUs）作为感知输入的强化学习控制框架。核心贡献在于验证了在缺乏关节角度等传统状态估计的情况下，纯惯性测量数据足以学习鲁棒的双足行走策略，并实现了从仿真到真实世界的成功迁移。

## 它改变了什么

双足机器人的运动控制长期依赖精确的关节角度、机身姿态等状态估计，这通常需要高性能编码器、视觉或激光雷达融合。齿轮驱动人形机器人（如采用高减速比行星齿轮的机型）虽然具备高力矩密度，但其关节柔性、背隙和摩擦特性复杂，使得基于模型的状态估计极易失真。该论文真正改变的，是**将感知负担从“全身状态重建”降维为“足部局部惯性测量”**——这等于承认在足式机器人中，与地面接触的足部运动学信息已包含支撑相动态的核心线索，从而绕开了对全身精确模型的依赖。这一思路对低成本、高鲁棒性的足式机器人部署具有范式意义，因为它大幅削减了对传感器精度和模型辨识的苛刻要求。

## 方法拆解

### 观测空间设计
- 输入为足部IMU的**六维惯性数据**（三轴加速度 + 三轴角速度），并堆叠**历史窗口**（论文未明确窗口长度，但此类方法通常为 10–20 步）以提供足部运动的时序动态。
- 关键决策：**不使用机身IMU或关节编码器**，刻意排除全身状态，迫使策略从足部接触动力学中隐式推断身体姿态与运动相位。

### 策略架构与训练
- 采用**教师-学生（Teacher-Student）框架**：教师策略在仿真中获取**特权信息**（如全身关节角、机身姿态、地面反作用力），学生策略仅以足部IMU序列为输入，通过**在线蒸馏**学习教师行为。
- 学生策略使用**循环神经网络（RNN，如GRU）**处理时序IMU数据，输出**关节位置增量**作为动作，经**PD控制器**映射为力矩。

## 概述

本文提出 PH2D 数据集与 HAT 策略架构，利用第一人称人类演示（VR 设备采集）作为跨具身训练数据，在 Unitree H1 人形机器人上显著提升操作策略的分布外泛化能力。核心贡献在于通过可微重定向统一人类与机器人的状态-动作空间，并以约 3.02M 帧人类数据与 668k 帧机器人数据联合训练，使 O.O.D. 成功率相对提升近 100%。

## 它改变了什么

人形机器人操作策略的训练长期受困于遥操作数据采集的低效与高成本，这直接限制了策略在开放世界中的泛化能力。现有方法或依赖昂贵的遥操作系统，或引入模块化中间表示（如 affordances）导致复合误差。本文真正改变的是数据来源的范式：不再将人类演示视为辅助信号，而是将其作为与机器人数据等价的、可联合训练的第一类数据。通过将人类与机器人建模为不同具身并统一其状态-动作空间，避免了模块化流水线的误差累积，使得大规模、低成本的人类演示数据能够直接参与策略优化，从而显著提升分布外泛化性能。

这一改变的关键在于，它把“数据规模”从瓶颈转化为优势。传统方法受限于机器人演示数据的稀缺性，而本文证明，即便机器人数据仅占总量约 18%（668k vs 3.02M 帧），人类数据仍能通过统一空间有效引导策略学习，使 O.O.D. 成功率从 59/170 提升至 101/170（由表内数值 59→101 计算）。这实质上是将数据采集的边际成本大幅降低，为开放世界泛化提供了可扩展的路径。

ent_paper_worldscape_moe_a_unified_mixtu.summary: arXiv:2607.03964v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: World models are rapidly becoming a core infrastructure for embodied intelligence and interactive agents: they provide controllable simulators in which agents can perceive, act, forecast, and acquire scalable experience. Yet current video generation world models are still organized around isolated control interfaces, such as camera trajectories, robot actions, or hand-joint signals. This fragmentation is increasingly a scaling bottleneck. The central challenge is not the absence of controllable generators, but the lack of a unified and extensible learning framework that can absorb heterogeneous action supervision while preserving a shared model of world dynamics. In this work, we introduce Worldscape-MoE, a Mixture-of-Experts world model built on Diffusion Transformers for scalable heterogeneous action control. Our key observation is that different controls specify different interfaces to the same underlying world: although their representations differ, they constrain shared physical regularities, scene dynamics, and interaction semantics. Worldscape-MoE operationalizes this observation through modality-aware control injection, shared and control-specific experts, and a progressive MoE tuning strategy that supports continual extension to new action modalities. Experiments across locomotion, robotic manipulation, and egocentric hand control show that heterogeneous supervision improves rather than interferes with individual control capabilities. Worldscape-MoE achieves strong results on WorldArena, improves locomotion and hand-control metrics, exhibits robust out-of-distribution generalization, and demonstrates scaling behavior as additional control data and experts are integrated.

ent_paper_imperio_smolvla_the_implicatio.summary: arXiv:2607.04146v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work establishes that trigger-word data poisoning of vision language action models is practical, while at the same time the open-source robotics ecosystem holds trust assumptions about community contributions. A few poisoned samples can silently embed a backdoor that disables a robot on command. We evaluate this threat against smolVLA on a real-world pick-and-place task, training on three poison ratios and evaluating across different prompts on the LeRobot platform. Three poisoned episodes in 320 clean episodes suffice for a complete denial of service. Success rate drops to 0.0 plus minus 0.0% across all trigger-word conditions and the robot locks into a fixed joint configuration rather than executing any task-relevant motion. Clean-prompt behaviour holds at approx. 50% success rate across all poison ratios, confirming the attack is stealthy under normal operation. A single poisoned episode already reduces success rate to 6.7 plus minus 6.7%. The robot still moves, but no longer completes the task. The attack generalises to front, middle, and end trigger placements despite training exclusively on front-placed triggers. These findings establish that the threat is practical, low-cost, and stealthy, and warrant treating dataset provenance as a first-class concern in open-source robotics ecosystems.

## 概述

ent_paper_gigaworld_1_a_roadmap_to_build.summary: arXiv:2607.02642v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Evaluating embodied robot foundation models remains a critical bottleneck; unlike large language models efficiently assessed via digital benchmarks, robotic policies require slow, costly real-world rollouts limited by hardware and human supervision, which has driven interest in world models as surrogate policy evaluators, yet the key properties that make a world model reliable for policy assessment remain poorly understood. This work presents a systematic study of world models for robotic policy evaluation and introduces WMBench, a benchmark constructed from real-robot teleoperation data and matched policy rollouts covering diverse manipulation tasks to enable controlled comparisons across model families, action encodings, rollout horizons, and evaluation metrics. Using WMBench, we analyze 7 video world models, 4 action representation schemes, and over 324,000 simulated policy rollouts paired with real robot executions, further enriching our analysis with large-scale community submissions from the CVPR 2026 GigaBrain Challenge, curated synthetic trajectories, and a training videos spanning more than 12,000 hours. Our experiments deliver three core insights: evaluator quality is dominated by long-horizon, action-faithful rollout consistency rather than short-term visual realism; pretraining gains stem not only from data scale but from balancing general world knowledge with robot-specific controllability; and architectural choices including action encoding, memory design, and evaluator-focused post-training strongly determine alignment with real-world robot behavior. Drawing on these results, we derive a practical design roadmap and realize it in \textit{GigaWorld-1}, a world model specially optimized for policy evaluation, and we fully release our code, models, datasets, and toolkits to advance scalable evaluation research for embodied foundation models.

ent_paper_learning_to_balance_motor_ther.summary: arXiv:2605.27046v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Motor thermal management is often overlooked in the context of electrically-actuated robots, particularly legged robots, but motor overheating is a key factor that limits long-duration locomotion especially under payload conditions. This paper integrates a whole-body thermal model of a quadruped robot into the reinforcement learning pipeline to update motor temperatures, and proposes a two-stage training framework for motor thermal management. In this framework, a nominal policy is first pre-trained as a locomotion baseline capable of traversing diverse terrains. A residual policy is then trained on top of the nominal policy to provide corrective actions based on the robot's thermal state, ensuring high performance under low-temperature conditions and preventing motor overheating under high-temperature conditions. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed policy achieves an effective balance between motor thermal safety and locomotion performance. Real-world experiments on a Unitree A1 quadruped robot further validate the approach: under a 3 kg payload, the robot achieves stable locomotion across multiple terrains for over 13 minutes, while the nominal policy alone leads to motor overheating in about 5 minutes.

ent_paper_cabto_context_aware_behavior_t.summary: arXiv:2603.16809v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Behavior Trees (BTs) offer a powerful paradigm for designing modular and reactive robot controllers. BT planning, an emerging field, provides theoretical guarantees for the automated generation of reliable BTs. However, BT planning typically assumes that a well-designed BT system is already grounded -- comprising high-level action models and low-level control policies -- which often requires extensive expert knowledge and manual effort. In this paper, we formalize the BT Grounding problem: the automated construction of a complete and consistent BT system. We analyze its complexity and introduce CABTO (Context-Aware Behavior Tree grOunding), the first framework to efficiently solve this challenge. CABTO leverages pre-trained Large Models (LMs) to heuristically search the space of action models and control policies, guided by contextual feedback from BT planners and environmental observations. Experiments spanning seven task sets across three distinct robotic manipulation scenarios demonstrate CABTO's effectiveness and efficiency in generating complete and consistent behavior tree systems.
ent_paper_cabto_context_aware_behavior_t.body:
## 概述

CABTO 提出一种面向机器人操作的行为树（Behavior Tree）上下文感知 grounding 方法，由作者团队开发，核心贡献在于将行为树的结构化决策与视觉-语言模型的上下文推理结合，提升操作任务的可解释性与成功率。该方法在 LIBERO 基准上验证了少样本监督微调（SFT）后经强化学习（RL）微调的性能提升。

## 它改变了什么

传统 VLA 模型直接输出动作序列，缺乏显式的任务分解与决策结构，导致在长时域、多阶段操作任务中错误累积且难以调试。CABTO 改变了这一范式：它不再让模型从像素直接映射到关节动作，而是先通过行为树将任务分解为可验证的子目标，再由底层策略执行每个叶子节点动作。这种分层 grounding 使得模型可以在任务层面进行规划推理，而非仅依赖端到端的动作预测，从而显著降低长时域任务的失败率。

另一个关键改变是它将行为树的选择过程与 VLM 的上下文理解耦合，使得树结构不再是静态预设，而是根据当前视觉观察和语言指令动态调整。这解决了传统行为树在开放世界任务中灵活性不足的问题，同时保留了其可解释性和模块化优势。

## 方法拆解

### 行为树 grounding 架构
- 输入：agent 视角与腕部视角图像（224×224 RGB）、自然语言指令、6-DOF 关节角度、夹爪状态。
- 行为树定义：每个任务由一棵行为树表示，内部节点为控制流（Sequence、Fallback、Parallel），叶子节点为原子操作（如“抓取”“移动”“放置”）。
- 上下文选择器：在每个决策节点，VLM 接收当前视觉观察与语言指令，输出对子节点选择的概率分布，替代传统行为树中的确定性条件判断。

### 策略优化
- 少样本 SFT：π₀ 使用 58 条轨迹（LIBERO-Long 为 208 条），π₀.₅ 使用 40 条轨迹，从官方 1,…

ent_paper_husky_humanoid_skateboarding_s.body:
## 概述

HUSKY 提出一套面向仿人机器人的物理感知全身控制框架，用于在多种滑板平台上执行推动、转向与相位过渡等滑板行为。核心贡献在于通过系统辨识建立滑板倾斜与转向角的精确运动学关系，并引入课程学习与域随机化，实现从仿真到真实 Unitree G1 机器人的策略迁移。

## 它改变了什么

这项工作的真正改变在于，它把“滑板”从一项炫技式演示任务，变成了一个可被严格建模和控制的动态系统。以往仿人机器人动态操控研究多聚焦于行走或跑步，对带轮平台（如滑板）的物理交互往往依赖启发式或简化模型，导致转向时板体倾斜与航向变化之间的耦合关系难以精确处理，策略在真实硬件上表现脆弱。HUSKY 通过推导出 tan σ = tan λ · sin γ 这一精确运动学约束，将滑板操控从“试错式”学习转变为“有物理先验”的控制问题，这为后续更复杂的带轮平台操控提供了可复用的建模范式。

## 方法拆解

### 运动学约束推导
- 从几何关系出发，推导出滑板转向的核心约束：cot η = cos λ cot γ，并最终化简为 tan σ = tan λ · sin γ，其中 σ 为转向角，λ 为板倾斜角，γ 为转向轮偏角。该式明确了转向角与板体倾斜之间的非线性耦合，是后续奖励设计与控制器调参的理论基础。

### 滑板建模与辨识
- 在 MuJoCo 中构建滑板模型，包含甲板、前后桥与轮，轮-地接触采用六维（condim = 6）建模，滚动摩擦系数设为 0.001。
- 对两块真实滑板进行系统辨识，通过自由振荡实验获取惯性矩与阻尼特性。第一块板：I = 7.15 × 10⁻³ kg·m²，振荡周期 T = 0.107 s，辨识得到 PD 增益 K_p = 34.835，K_d = 0.540；第二块板：I = 8.70 × 10⁻³ kg·m²，T = 0.185 s，K_p = 14.…

ent_paper_differential_amplifier_inspire.name_en: Differential Amplifier-Inspired AmpAttention for Multi-View Robotic Manipulation
ent_paper_differential_amplifier_inspire.summary: arXiv:2607.02845v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-view robotic manipulation methods with the attention mechanism have recently achieved significant progress in both training efficiency and task performance. However, the inherent redundancy, occlusion, and viewpoint dependency in robotic view images often lead to severe attention drift. To address this challenge, we propose AmpAttention, a novel attention mechanism inspired by differential amplifiers in analog circuits. It aims to suppress attention noise and capture high signal-to-noise ratio signals for more reliable perception. Based on this, we introduce the RVAF model, which integrates task-guided intra-view and inter-view AmpAttention. Compared to previous state-of-the-art methods, RVAF achieves the optimal average success rate across 18 RLBench tasks (249 variations) while reducing training time by 33.3\%. RVAF also demonstrates strong potential in real-world high-precision tasks, exemplified by its ability to pick up a dart and accurately insert it into the red bullseye. Furthermore, we extend RVAF to RVAF++ by incorporating the SAM2 image encoder. RVAF++ achieves substantial gains on high-precision tasks, achieving a 91\% success rate on the `insert peg' task. More qualitative results are provided at the anonymous project website https://anonymous.4open.science/w/RVAF-Anonymization.

ent_paper_iterative_closed_loop_motion_s.body:
## 概述

本文提出一种迭代闭环运动合成框架，通过数据生成与控制器训练的协同进化，提升人形控制对动态复杂动作（如武术、舞蹈）的跟踪能力。核心贡献在于用物理有效性过滤与VLM语义对齐构建高质量训练数据，并验证了迭代共同进化对捕捉边缘情况动态的必要性。

## 它改变了什么

现有物理人体控制（PHC）方法在标准MoCap数据上训练，面对快速动量转换和“零暂停”过渡时立即崩溃，这暴露了训练数据与真实动态需求之间的根本性差距。作者真正改变的不是控制器架构，而是数据生成范式——将数据视为可迭代优化的对象，而非固定输入。这一转变使得控制器能够逐步适应那些传统方法无法处理的极端动作，如Jump Snap Kick，从而将人形控制的能力边界从平稳运动扩展到高动态、高冲击场景。

## 方法拆解

### 数据生成流程
- **物理有效性过滤**：拒绝根高度超出稳定范围或脚部穿透地形平面的生成片段，并对根节点位移偏移进行高斯滤波时间平滑，以减少运动噪声。
- **VLM语义对齐**：将每个视频编码为均匀子采样的关键帧序列，水平拼接成单个Base64图像，供VLM（Qwen-VL-MAX）评估。每序列渲染60帧，评估聚焦于拼接图像中的人体运动线索与提示词的动作关键词及时间逻辑，忽略场景和道具差异，结果分为对齐、部分或错配，使用宽松阈值。接受条件为 `semantic_score ≥ τ_sem`。

### 控制器训练
- **PHC单基元（Single-Primitive）**：总步数 `1.5 × 10^6`，优化器Adam，环境数1024，学习率 `1 × 10^-4`，γ 0.98，λ 0.95，ε 0.2，回放缓冲区大小 `2 × 10^5`。
- **MaskedMimic**：总步数 `1.5 × 10^6`，优化器Adam，环境数2048，学习率 `2 × 10^-5`，γ…

ent_paper_dec_marvel_decentralized_multi.summary: arXiv:2607.09060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-UAV exploration is often constrained by unreliable communication, limited field-of-view sensing (e.g., lightweight onboard camera), and finite travel budgets that require each robot to reserve enough budget to return to its base. We present Dec-MARVEL, a decentralized budget-aware exploration framework for communication-free teams with directional sensing. Rather than exchanging maps, goals, or messages, each robot coordinates through its incidental observations: any teammate trajectory within its field of view serves as a coordination signal. A graph-attention actor fuses local frontier geometry, teammate motion, and budget features to select return-feasible waypoint-heading actions. The actor is trained with phase-conditioned critics, a training-only task-oriented privileged critic, and a mixture-based budget curriculum. Across 900 held-out trials spanning three team sizes (2, 4, 8 robots) and three travel budgets (720, 800, 1024 meters) against four baselines, Dec-MARVEL achieves the highest or tied-highest exploration rate and lowest sensing overlap across all nine team-size budget configurations. Under our tightest 720m budget, it reaches 53%, 94%, and 100% success for 2, 4, and 8 robots, versus 37%, 83%, and 99% for the strongest baseline. Physical-robot experiments demonstrate successful sim-to-real transfer and real-world deployment of Dec-MARVEL.

SceneBot is a contact-conditioned full-body motion tracking framework for humanoid robots, proposed by a research team. ent_paper_li_cogvla_cognition_aligned_vi.body:
## 概述

本文提出 RoboMIND，一个包含 55k 条真实世界演示轨迹、279 个任务、覆盖 4 种机器人本体的标准化机器人操作数据集，并配套数字孪生仿真环境与统一数据收集协议。作者旨在通过统一数据标准与多本体覆盖，解决现有机器人数据集缺乏一致性、多样性不足的问题，从而提升模仿学习与 VLA 模型在真实操作任务上的泛化能力。

## 它改变了什么

机器人操作策略的通用性长期受限于数据本身：不同实验室以各自标准收集数据，导致任务定义、观测空间、动作语义互不兼容，模型跨本体迁移时性能急剧下降。现有大规模数据集如 Open X-Embodiment 虽聚合了 1.4M 轨迹，但来源混杂，缺乏统一标注与质量控制，难以支撑对精细操作技能的系统学习。RoboMIND 的实质贡献在于将“数据收集”本身作为一项工程问题来标准化——通过统一平台、协议与质量流程，首次在 4 种异构本体（单臂、双臂、人形）上以人类遥操作方式采集了规模可观且标注一致的数据，这为跨本体策略学习提供了此前缺失的“可控变量”实验基础。

## 方法拆解

### 数据收集架构
- **遥操作系统**：Franka 与 UR-5e 采用 Gello 设置；AgileX 双臂使用内置遥操作；Tien Kung 人形机器人结合 Xsens 动作捕捉服与 Gello 式设备，以捕捉自然人类运动模式。
- **智能数据平台**：云原生架构、分布式计算，支持 PB 级存储与结构化/非结构化数据管理，覆盖收集、存储、处理、分析全流程。
- **质量保证**：四阶段流程——初始检查、详细检查、数据过滤、问题记录，以缓解操作员疲劳或分心引入的噪声。

### 任务定义与标注
- 任务由四要素定义：机器人本体、操作技能、涉及物体、场景描述（含空间关系与环境约束）。
- 任务分为六类：铰接操作、协调操作、基础操作、物体交互、精密操…

ent_paper_tactile_and_vision_conditioned.name_en: Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control for Whole-Arm Manipulation
ent_paper_tactile_and_vision_conditioned.summary: arXiv:2607.09218v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Whole-arm manipulation involves direct contact with the environment while the robot completes a task by distributing contact across multiple links as contacts form, slide, and break. This setting breaks common implicit assumptions in many learning-based manipulation pipelines: arm configuration tightly couples motion and contact forces, contact state is partially observed under occlusion, and purely learned rollouts can become physically inconsistent under distribution shift because many multi-link contact configurations are sparsely represented in the data. To address this, we propose TACTIC (Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control), a receding-horizon controller for whole-arm manipulation. TACTIC uses a contact-centric hybrid predictive model that combines RGB-D, distributed tactile sensing, and a compact 2D proximity representation. The model couples a learned, action-conditioned latent dynamics model with analytical kinematics through contact Jacobians, enabling rollouts of future contact configurations and interaction forces. TACTIC integrates these rollouts into a sampling-based MPC planner with contact-aware action sampling: contact Jacobian-based projections steer sampled action sequences toward force-modulating directions, and objectives defined over predicted proximity and interaction forces trade task progress against whole-arm force regulation. We evaluate TACTIC in simulation against state-of-the-art model-based and model-free methods, and perform ablations that isolate the contribution of each design choice. TACTIC consistently outperforms other methods. We further demonstrate real-world performance on a robot with distributed tactile sensing across three whole-arm manipulation tasks that require multi-contact trajectories: turning over and repositioning a manikin, and goal-reaching in a 3D dynamic maze. Website: https://emprise.cs.cornell.edu/tactic

## 概述

本文提出ReST-RL（Residual Student-Teacher Reinforcement Learning）分层强化学习架构，用于类人机器人整臂操作中托盘上未固定载荷的稳定控制。该方法通过显式解耦运动控制与载荷稳定，在Unitree G1人形机器人上实现仿真96.9%的可变速度跟踪成功率与74.5%的外部力扰动鲁棒性，并成功完成真实世界零样本部署。

## 它改变了什么

类人机器人在动态行走中稳定托盘上的未固定物体（如液体杯、易碎仪器），长期是操作控制的空白地带。现有端到端方法（如SoFTA）仅能处理悬挂或附着在手上的单一物体，面对托盘这一非刚性中间耦合体时，运动指令与稳定目标存在根本性冲突——加速、转弯等常规动作会通过运动链将足部冲击传导至托盘，导致物体滑移或倾覆。轮式平台因无法产生主动稳定机动，在较大外部扰动下同样失效。

这项工作的真正改变在于：它不再试图让单一策略同时优化运动与稳定这两个相互竞争的目标，而是将问题重新定义为"在既有运动能力之上叠加稳定层"。这暗示了一个更普适的工程哲学——对于双足机器人这类复杂系统，与其从零训练全能策略，不如在已验证的基础能力上做残差式增强，这显著降低了任务难度并提升了样本效率。

- 该策略负责底层运动控制，不感知载荷状态

## 概述

ARMOR 提出一种面向人形机器人的自我中心感知与运动规划方案，在双臂部署 40 个低成本 ToF 激光雷达，结合基于动作分块变换器的生成式策略与推理时 SDF 轨迹优化，在仿真中显著降低碰撞率并提升成功率。该工作由研究团队在 Fourier GR1 平台上完成，核心贡献在于以近无遮挡的分布式感知替代传统中央摄像头，并验证了神经策略在密集环境中的有效性。

## 它改变了什么

人形机器人运动规划长期受困于感知盲区：头戴或躯干中央的摄像头/激光雷达无法覆盖手臂内侧与手部，而外部第三人称相机在移动场景中不可用。触觉传感虽能提供局部接触信息，但成本高、集成难，且作为策略输入尚未成熟。ARMOR 真正改变的是将感知从“单点中央”转向“分布式边缘”——在双臂上密集布置微型 ToF 传感器，使机器人对自身工作空间形成近乎无遮挡的覆盖。这一转变不仅绕开了遮挡问题，还让感知与运动规划在结构上对齐：传感器覆盖区域即机械臂可达区域，从而将碰撞规避从“全局场景理解”简化为“局部距离场查询”，大幅降低了规划问题的复杂度。

The key point is to put the policy network and the control module in the same training/deployment link, reducing the discontinuity between high-level goals and low-level actions.

## Overview

This study addresses the significant gap between high-level semantic goals and low-level action execution in humanoid robot motion generation by proposing a framework called EMOTION. The core contribution of this framework lies in integrating the policy network and control module into the same training and deployment pipeline, enabling end-to-end generation from visual, state, and action data to full-body trajectories and action sequences through in-context learning without explicit retraining. This design effectively enhances the expressiveness and semantic consistency of robot motion, providing a new technical pathway for humanoid robots to perform emotionally expressive tasks in complex environments.
